NAME: Ellie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Introducing Sweet little Ellie! Ellie can be a little shy at first with new people, but with some patience and love you will soon see her affectionate and goofy playful sides come out! Ellie love her treats and her toys and we have found it to be a super rewarding experience to win her over! She may even delight you with her spontaneous joyful zoomies (that last approximately 7 seconds before she needs a nap). Ellie would suit a relaxed and laid back home and lifestyle and would love a backyard or courtyard to call her own. She is happy to share her home with another medium-large dog, or could spend a few hours chilling alone during the day as a single dog. Older, respectful kids/teens are suitable, provided they can give Ellie space when she needs a break. If you think you can give Ellie the loving home she deserves, apply online today to adopt this sweet girl!

NAME: Sam (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *I'm in foster care -read my update below!* He loves to play with his toys, he will spontaneously launch into little play sessions, rooting around in his toy box to see what takes his fancy, spinning around and flinging things in the air! He is as good as gold in the house. He takes himself outside when he needs to during the day, and we rarely hear a peep out of him overnight. He seems quite happy to be left for several hours at a time when everyone's out, on a few occasions he's spent 8-10 hours home alone. No chewing or damage to anything when we get home. He is pretty mellow and snoozy for much of the day when left to his own devices. He's shown no interest in getting on our beds or sofas, he's content with his own bed and a nice rug. He loves his walks He loves people and is very affectionate and generous with his kisses! I think in a perfect world Sam would love a garden he could zoomie around in, or the opportunity to stretch his legs in a safe off-leash environment. He is a smart, inquisitive, entertaining and friendly boy, and very easy to love" ----- Looking for a fun-loving, people-obsessed companion? Sam the greyhound is your guy! 🐾 With his playful personality and endless enthusiasm, he’s ready to steal your heart and bring joy to every adventure. Sam is a total people pleaser, always eager for his human's attention and affection. He’s incredibly social and loves to be around his people, making him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a friendly, outgoing dog. Sam is also pro when it comes to car rides—he loves hopping in for a fun adventure and travels like a champ. Whether it’s exploring new environments or playing with his favorite toys, Sam is always up for the next exciting thing! He’s also a big fan of walks, where his playful, excitable personality shines. Sam is suitbale for living with other dogs around his size and would also be happy to share his home with older kids. If you’re looking for a fun, loving, and energetic pup to share your life with, Sam is your guy! 🐕💙 Contact the Western Sydney team to meet Sam today!

NAME: Mindy
TEXT: *I've just gone to foster care!* Mindy is a little shy at first, but with a chance to warm up, she'll be showing you her goofy side in no time! Full time or part time workers may work for Mindy, she will just need a chance to build up to longer hours alone. Mindy would best suit a quiet home, with adults or older children to ease her into pet life. Although Mindy has been appropriate during her interactions with other dogs of all sizes, she would prefer to be the only dog in her new home, so she can have all the love to herself. Mindy loves a treat and has proven to be a real smarty pants, learning "down", "touch" and "shake" on cue! She has shown to settle well when left alone and while indoors, but would prefer a home with a yard or courtyard to have a play or a snooze. Come down and meet Mindy at Western Sydney!

NAME: Romeo
TEXT: *Romeo is in a foster care home in the Inner West* Foster Update: Romeo is super happy, affectionate and playful pup (no resource guarding or sleep startle observed). He is quite confident and outgoing at home. When he’s asleep he is angelic and when he is awake, he is effervescent. He has settled in quickly, he knows where his beds are and has a sleep bed and a play bed, he figured out very quickly where his toys live and how to dig the goat horn his favourite toy out of the basket. Romeo is a quick learner and has now mastered indoor and outdoor steps. He is responding to his name most of the time. His playful antics make us laugh to no end. He is happy to pass dogs on a footpath without much notice. Favourite things about him: His beautiful soulful eyes, his stunning looks, his mischievous personality, his independence and his affectionate behaviour. *Romeo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre via appointment with his foster carer*

NAME: Bucket
TEXT: This pretty girl is great sharing her space with other hounds, she is playful and fun, she likes toys. She lives in an area surrounded by native and farm animals.

NAME: Snippy
TEXT: Snippy is a relaxed, friendly, easy-going gentleman, who’s not jumpy and a dream on the lead. He’s super social, affectionate, and loves spending time with people - he just adores the grandkids aged 6 and up! Snippy’s happy nature makes him an excellent pet - he LOVES to lean on you and get cuddles, which we just love! He’s great with other calm natured greys, and would prefer shorter hours alone as a solo pet. He loves his daily walks, swimming adventures, and is very food-motivated making him a breeze to train. He’d thrive in a home with someone who has time to hang out with him and has a nice quiet backyard for him to chill out in. Snippy has mastered stairs so a home with some steps is A-O-K! This friendly fella is at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ryan
TEXT: Ryan has just come back from a foster care home over Christmas — keep reading to find out why his foster carer loved him so much! "Ryan is a sweet, gentle soul with the calmest nature you’ll ever meet. He loves lounging near you quietly, always happy to just be in your presence. He walks beautifully on the lead, gets along well with people, and has such expressive eyes that tell you exactly how he’s feeling. He’s low-maintenance, clean, and well-behaved around the house. He enjoys short walks and long naps, and has a soft spot for comfy bedding and gentle pats. While I’ve come to care for him deeply, I’ve realised I’m not quite ready for a dog at this stage. Ryan deserves a home where he can be someone’s forever companion. He’ll make an incredible addition to any calm, loving household." Ryan would suit a full-time working family, with a backyard. He is outgoing and friendly with people, loves treats and would also suit a home with another medium-large canine companion. Ryan loves his walks around the adoption centre (pictured!) — and did we mention he’s super smart? 🐾 He already knows “on your bed,” “down,” and “shake,” among plenty of other tricks he’s learned in pet training. Ryan’s waiting for his new best friends to pick him up at the Western Sydney Adoption Centre — could that be you?

NAME: Stavros
TEXT: *Stavros is living in foster care with another dog!* Stavros is a beautiful boy that’s full of love and life! He has spent the last few months in a foster care home with 6 other dogs. Stavros would be best suited to a home with 1 other doggie friend. 6 was fun, but he's about quality, not quantity! If Stavros lives as your only dog, you can go off to work during the day and he'll be happy on his own for full time hours. Stavros is fond of a run around and play time but also loves giving and receiving lots of affection. An adults only home is the best fit for this gentle giant. He has a playful side and loves to have fun! Stavros would be a great addition to an apartment home (with lift access - no stairs) with an active lifestyle, or a house with a yard.

NAME: Lou
TEXT: If you're looking for a friendly and outgoing companion, check out Lou! Lou has recently spent time in foster care where he mastered going to markets and meeting all the stall holders. Lou is a sweet, people-focused boy who enjoys routine, gentle companionship, and having his humans within eyesight. He walks beautifully on lead, took inner-city living in stride during foster care, and happily relaxed at cafés, pubs, and markets. He’s polite with other dogs on walks, enjoys calm play with other greyhounds, and absolutely adores squeaky toys and fetch. Lou is independent but affectionate, active in the mornings, and a cosy snoozer by evening when he has a comfortable spot to unwind. He will do best in a house with yard access, as smaller apartments made it difficult for him to fully settle and find his own space. When sharing a home with a medium–large dog, he benefits from structure around resting places and clear routines to keep everyone comfortable. Lou is a loving, joyful companion who thrives when given room to relax, predictable guidance, and a household that enjoys his mix of active playtime and peaceful downtime. Read below to see what Lou's foster carers had to say about him! "Lou is a beautiful boy with a lot of love to give. He walks very very well on the lead, ignores most birds and bush turkeys. He is not very interested in saying hi to other dogs and will respectfully walk straight past them. He loves squeaky toys with a passion and plays fetch with them with so much joy. He is a master of stairs. He would benefit from living in a house with a backyard, as our small apartment was a bit tight for him (he likes a safe space). In saying that he still wants to be within eyesight of you. He’s an independent but people loving doggie. He would benefit from an active owner - he is full of beans and loves longer walks and play time. He is most active in the mornings and is up for cuddles and play time, in the evening he likes to curl up and snooze independently." Apply now to meet Lou from our Western Sydney program.

NAME: Sal
TEXT: Meet Sal 💕She is a beautiful-natured, sweet, friendly, and easy-going young girl who’s ready to find her forever home. She loves a run around the yard with her fox terrier friends, then is perfectly content to relax and enjoy some rest time. Sal has been swimming in the pool and splashing in her shell pool in the heat, and she’s also very comfortable around parrots and other aviary birds in her backyard. Sal enjoys being around her people and loves lying in the laundry or heading inside whenever she gets the chance. She’s well-socialised and used to children of all ages, including little ones as young as 3, as well as older kids and teens, small dogs, other greys and also cats. Sal would suit a family home or any household where someone has the time to spend with her and help her happy, loving nature continue to shine. Sal will male a wonderful family pet or a loyal companion who simply loves being part of everyday life. 🐾💖

NAME: Yukey
TEXT: Meet Yukey! 🐶💖 Yukey is a sweet and playful girl with a heart full of love and sunshine! Yukey walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys playtime with her toys and doggy friends. She’s equally happy to chill out and watch the world go by, making her a wonderful balance of fun and calm. If you're ready to open your home to a girl full of love, personality, and charm, Yukey is ready to meet you!

NAME: Roy
TEXT: Introducing Roy, the ultimate sweetheart who will steal your heart with his gentle and loving nature! Roy is a placid and soft-natured boy who adores receiving pats and cuddles from his humans. His loving demeanor will make you fall head over heels for him in no time. Roy is wonderful around children ages 6 to 15, other dogs big and small, and even cats, making him a versatile companion for any type of household. He is well-behaved and housetrained, as well as crate-trained, so you can trust him to be a well-mannered addition to your family. This easy-going boy walks well on a leash but doesn't need a lot of exercise, making him a great fit for families who enjoy relaxing at home. Roy has short bursts of energy and is happy to spend his time lounging around or exploring with you, loving his car rides. If you are looking for a low-maintenance and loving addition to your family, Roy is the perfect match for you. Come meet this wonderful boy today and see how he can brighten up your household with his gentle spirit and sweet nature!

NAME: Nacho
TEXT: Nacho is an extremely friendly and happy boy. He has no issues with anybody. He is very keen and confident, great on the lead and open to new experiences. Responds well to his name and is comfortable and confident when left alone.

NAME: Fatty
TEXT: Fatty is a superstar hound who can live anywhere and get along with anybody and everybody. He goes on daily walks, lives amongst a range of animals and is cuddly and affectionate also. He is inquisitive and confident and responds well to his name. He can also do stairs.

NAME: Murphy
TEXT: Murphy is a typical boy who likes to stretch out in the yard and fetch a ball. He is on the active side however he does appreciate a cuddle and some affection also. He is a fun friendly boy who gets along with everyone, he will sometimes be unaware of his size.l He is great company.

NAME: Bluey
TEXT: He's small. He's blue. And he's ready to become the love of your life. Introducing Bluey! This gorgeous 4-year-old blue boy has a delightful, playful personality and just loves to bounce around and chase after his toys in a game of fetch. He loves everyone he meets and will snuggle right into you to politely ask for pats. Bluey loves other medium-large dogs and would be most successful in a home with a canine companion to share his down time with while the humans are away. Older, respectful kids are suitable and would enjoy playing with Bluey, as long as they are able to give him a break when he's ready for a snooze. A home with a courtyard or backyard is exactly what Bluey is dreaming of - somewhere to enjoy a zoomie or play session in throughout the day. If little Bluey sounds like your perfect match, apply to adopt him today! He is available at our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Tiger
TEXT: Beautiful brindle Tiger wants to meet you! This super loving and outgoing 4-year-old boy loves to go up to everyone and see if he can get a pat (or a treat!). He has a excellent food motivation and is responding very well to early training and has even already learned to navigate a full flight of stairs! He just loves to learn new things and play enrichment games that let him use his big brains. Tiger would do best in a home without other dogs and children so he can soak up all the love and attention for himself. He doesn't mind some hours alone to chill out while you're away at work - just leave him with some long-lasting enrichment activities and he will be good as gold! A small backyard or courtyard would be preferred so Tiger can enjoy the occasional zoomie. Is Tiger your new best friend? Apply online today to meet this gorgeous boy.

NAME: Eric
TEXT: Eric is a friendly, well-mannered dog with a calm and social nature that makes him easy to love. He’s polite in his interactions and genuinely enjoys the company of others,especially medium to large dogs. Onsite, Eric has done really well socialising, even happily spending time with a Husky cross, which shows his confidence and friendly approach to canine friendships. Eric would do best in a home where someone is around more often than not, especially in the beginning, to help him settle in and feel secure. While he enjoys human companionship, we also believe that a doggy companion could really help him thrive, build confidence, and fully enjoy home and pet life. With his gentle temperament and friendly personality, Eric has all the qualities of a wonderful family dog. He’s the kind of companion who is happy to be involved, kind with those around him, and ready to form strong bonds with both people and pups. If you’re looking for a sweet, social dog who will blossom with a little support and a lot of love, Eric could be your perfect match. 💙

NAME: Savannah
TEXT: Meet Savannah! This sweet senior girl loves her pats and cuddles and loves nothing more than being around her people getting attention. Savannah is good with visiting kids 10 years old and older. Savannah enjoys going for leisurely walks or playing with toys in the backyard, but she also loves lounging around the house and getting belly rubs. She is well-mannered and has had lots of handling and inside experience, so you can trust her to be on her best behaviour. She even likes to 'sit' of her own accord. Although Savannah is happy to entertain herself, she would thrive in a moderately active household with a someone or a couple who enjoy spending time with her. She is also okay being left alone for periods of time, making her a great fit for workers. Savannah would do best as the only dog in the household, as she prefers to have all the attention to herself. If you are looking for a loyal and loving companion, Savannah is the dog for you. Come meet her today and see if she is your perfect match.

NAME: Jimmothy
TEXT: Goofy little Jimmothy will steal your heart and never give it back! Jimmothy is a super funny and adorable guy who will have you in stitches 24/7! He is best known for his bouncy, goofy nature, his spontaneous zoomies and giving the best cuddles in the world! As soon as you sit on the floor or the couch, he is right there next to you laying on your lap asking for pats! He loves other dogs, big and small, and would gladly join a family with other dogs in the picture. As a single dog, Jimmothy is suitable for part-time hours alone at home. He loves being indoors but would also enjoy a small courtyard or backyard to stretch his legs and perhaps toss his toys around merrily in. Respectful kids are suitable and would enjoy his cuddly, playful nature, provided they are able to give Jimmothy his space when he needs a break. Jimmothy truly is one-of-a-kind and we know he is going to bring you joy every day! Submit your application for Jimmothy if you'd like to meet him!

NAME: Bailey
TEXT: Meet Bailey – your happy blue best mate! Bailey is a beautiful, friendly blue boy who adores kids (6+) and loves nothing more than a game of chase and plenty of pats. He’s a joyful, affectionate lad who’s sure to bring laughter, love, and warmth into his new home. Bailey gets along well with his Greyhound pals as well as smaller dog friends (a Mini Groodle, Mini Foxy, Pug, and Kelpie x), so he’d happily share his home with another friendly dog. He’s a pretty chill chap, who loves being inside with you, is house-trained and crate-trained, and would suit a townhouse or house. Bailey is not over-energetic but loves a walk and carrying around his squeaky toys then happy to lie in his crate or help you around the house for a bit. If you’re looking for a loving, playful and easy care chap who’s great with kids and ready to be part of a family or any household, Bailey’s your boy! 💙

NAME: Skye
TEXT: Adorable 3-year-old Skye is looking for her forever home! Skye is a sweet, affectionate and bouncy little girl with a playful side that will entertain you to no end! She is friendly with other dogs around her size and would gladly share her new home with one. Older, respectful kids are suitable and would enjoy her playful side, provided they can give Skye a break when she needs it. If sweet Skye is the girl for you, apply to take her home today!

NAME: Jane
TEXT: Say hello to sweet little Jane! Jane is is wiggly, playful little thing and will delight you with her zoomies and tossing her toys around! She can be a little bit nervous at first but warms up nicely. A home willing to take new things slow with her as she settles in is best. Older, respectful kids are suitable provided they are able to give Jane a break when she needs a snooze to recharge. Jane would love to meet you! Apply online today and let us know you are interested in her.

NAME: Grace (Western Sydney )
TEXT: Grace is a bright, energetic girl who’s always on the go and ready for her next adventure. She loves to explore her surroundings and would thrive in a home that can keep up with her active, curious nature. Whether it’s sniffing out new spots or heading out for a walk, Grace is happiest when she’s moving. Her ideal home would be a house with a securely fenced yard where she can stretch her legs and burn off energy. She’d do best with older children who can match her size and excitement. Grace could live with another greyhound, but any canine companion would need to be medium to lard in size, playful and tolerant. If you’re looking for a fun-loving, active dog with loads of personality and potential, Grace might just be your girl

NAME: Tina
TEXT: Hi, I’m Tina! Tina is a confident and friendly girl who enjoys the company of people and being part of everyday life. She would be best suited to a house with a yard so she can zoom around and soak up the sunrays. Tina is still getting the hang of pet life and would suit a home where someone is around for part of the day while she is learning her new routine.

NAME: Keith
TEXT: Keith is a handsome black greyhound with a touch of grey that only adds to his character — and don’t let it fool you, he’s still as active as ever. He’s social with smaller dogs and has a very easy-going, engaging nature that makes him a joy to be around. Keith loves company and would likely benefit from having a canine friend at home to share his days with. With his relaxed attitude and friendly personality, Keith would make a wonderful, loyal companion.

NAME: Lukey
TEXT: Lukey is a gorgeous brindle greyhound with a friendly, easygoing nature. He’s social with smaller dogs and enjoys getting out and about with nice, loose-lead walking manners. Lukey is very engaging with people and absolutely loves his cuddles, happily leaning in for affection. He also has a playful side that comes out once he’s comfortable, making him a lovely mix of fun and calm. Lukey would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a sweet, affectionate greyhound with a bit of sparkle.

NAME: Arrow
TEXT: Arrow is a striking black male greyhound with loads of energy and a playful spirit. He’s still building his confidence and engagement with people, but once he feels comfortable, he really enjoys pats and quiet affection. Arrow is a very active boy who loves to play and would suit a home ready to match his enthusiasm. At this stage, he’s not suitable to live with small dogs. On lead, Arrow can become excited and will benefit from some initial training and guidance to help him settle into walks. With patience, structure, and a bit of fun, Arrow has all the potential to shine.

NAME: Streak
TEXT: Streak is a handsome black male greyhound with a gentle, charming nature. He offers a polite introduction to new situations and is very workable, including being comfortable around small dogs. Streak travels well and settles easily, making him a great companion for outings or adventures. He enjoys a good burst of zoomies when the mood strikes, but he’s just as happy to slow down for cuddles afterward. Very engaging with people, Streak loves human attention and forms sweet connections with those around him. He’s a wonderful mix of playful energy and affectionate calm.

NAME: Zellie
TEXT: Zellie is a stunning black female greyhound with a beautifully easy-going nature. She travels well and is comfortably crated in her current home, making her a smooth fit for everyday routines. Zellie absolutely adores big cuddles and is happiest when she can lean in close for affection. She’s social and well-balanced, having enjoyed a lovely interaction with an Italian greyhound and fantastic playtime with another greyhound. With her gentle temperament, affectionate personality, and adaptable nature, Zellie would make a wonderful companion for a home looking for a calm, loving greyhound who also knows how to have fun.

NAME: Lulu
TEXT: Lulu is a beautiful black female Greyhound with a confident, engaging personality. She is polite and well-mannered around other Greyhounds and has shown she can be small-dog workable, including a lovely, calm interaction with Syd the Schnauzer. Lulu travels well and takes new experiences in stride, making her a great companion for outings or trips. She’s friendly without being pushy, enjoys engaging with her people, and carries herself with quiet confidence. With her gentle nature and adaptable attitude, Lulu would make a wonderful addition to a home looking for a sweet, social Greyhound who can fit comfortably into everyday life.

NAME: Maestro
TEXT: *IN FOSTER* Meet Maestro 🎶 Maestro the handsome has just stepped paws into a foster care home - an apartment in Sydney! Check in for updates soon! Maestro is a happy, big-hearted dog who knows how to enjoy the good things in life. His three greatest loves are food, affection, and toys, and he approaches all of them with pure enthusiasm. Treats are the fastest way to his heart, but cuddles and playtime come in a very close second. Maestro is a friendly, social guy who does well with other dogs and enjoys their company. Whether it’s a shared walk, a play session, or just hanging out together, he’s comfortable having canine friends around. He’s the kind of dog who will happily celebrate every meal, proudly show off his favourite toy, and soak up all the love you’re willing to give. If you’re looking for a sweet, fun-loving companion who brings joy and warmth into your home, Maestro might be the perfect match for you. Come meet Maestro and see if he’s ready to make beautiful music with your family. 💛🐾

NAME: Miguel
TEXT: Say Hola to our beautiful boy Miguel! This adorable, bouncy little guy is going to make the best pet! Miguel is an outgoing boy who absolutely loves people, getting out for a stroll and about and playing with his humans. He's a clever cookie who loves food, making him very trainable and fun to teach new things. Miguel would love a chilled out home environment with a backyard to call his own to play and relax in. He would prefer to be the only pet in the household so he can take all the love and attention for himself. He has shown he has potential to work slowly up to longer hours alone and has mastered crate training as well. So if you're looking for a fun-loving and trainable companion, Miguel is your guy! Apply to adopt this handsome boy online today.

NAME: Stanley
TEXT: Stanley is lovely, friendly, soft-natured boy who loves to cuddle. He has a quiet nature and just loves to be around you and check out what you're doing as you go about your day - a sticky beak! He is an easy-going, gentle lad who will be your best friend. Stanley is the perfect gentleman and companion for retirees or workers, he doesn't need much of a walk or trips in the car, he's just happy to hang about at home. Stanley isn’t an energetic boy, very easy-care who would make a wonderful pet, also great with the grandchildren 9 and 13 when they come to visit. 🐾💙

NAME: Stripes
TEXT: Stripes is a handsome male greyhound with a calm, easy-going nature that makes him a wonderful companion. He is quiet, well-behaved, and truly no trouble at all. Stripes is very chilled and independent, happy to relax and enjoy his own space. He sleeps inside, settles easily, and takes everything in his stride. He also loves car rides and travels beautifully. Good with small dogs and gentle in his manner, Stripes would suit a home looking for a relaxed, low-maintenance greyhound who enjoys a peaceful lifestyle and quiet companionship.

NAME: Princess
TEXT: Princess is a sweet and happy 3-year-old greyhound who is an absolute pleasure to have around. Easy going and no trouble at all, she has a calm nature that makes her a joy to live with. Princess likes her own space and is very good at settling herself. She happily puts herself to bed in her crate and, after a burst of zoomies, will often take herself straight back to bed for a well-earned nap. With her gentle personality and sensible habits, Princess would suit a home looking for a relaxed and well-mannered companion who knows how to enjoy both playtime and quiet time.

NAME: Ellie
TEXT: Ellie is a beautiful 2-year-old female greyhound with a heart as big as her smile. Happy, playful, and affectionate, she is truly one of the loveliest dogs you will ever meet. 💕 Ellie adores people and has a gentle, friendly nature that makes her a joy to be around. She gets along wonderfully with dogs of all sizes and would happily share her home with a canine companion. Ellie also loves her toys and will entertain herself (and you!) with her playful antics. Great with kids and full of love to give, Ellie would make a fantastic family dog. She’s ready to settle into a home where she can be part of everyday life, enjoy playtime, and soak up plenty of affection.

NAME: Jude
TEXT: ** I am currently in a foster home for Christmas, read updates below!* "Jude (AKA Jude the Dude) is a sweet, funny and friendly boy who truly just wants to hang out with his people. Jude settles in quickly and has grown confident exploring main roads, local parks, and new routines. He’s been friendly with everyone he’s met, including children and loves a calm hello and a good pat. Jude is often complimented on his handsome looks and warm, gentle nature. He’s a bit of a water baby and absolutely loves beach walks and splashing through the water. Jude has been great with dogs of all sizes, though he seems most comfortable with slightly smaller dogs. Jude walks beautifully on lead and knows his routines well. He’s a great sleeper, adores his morning walk and has learned commands like “go to your bed,” when it's time to put his collar on or when we need to leave the house without him. Jude would suit city or suburban living and would love a canine companion, though he’s also content on his own and copes well being left for longer periods. He is a stair master and can get in and out of cars fine, though he sometimes might need a helping hand. We’ve absolutely adored having Jude in our home and know he’ll bring so much love and joy to his future family." ----------------------- Jude is a sweet lad, who is suitable to live with small or big dogs. He is a confident boy who would do well in urban/city environments and would suit shorter hours alone and an active, fun lifestyle. He would prefer a home without stairs but could live in a unit with a lift access. This affectionate, calm boy would be a lovely match for a family with respectful children, too. Meet Jude at Western Sydney.

NAME: Fawn
TEXT: Fawn is a super social girl with a big personality and a love for being around people. She enjoys making friends and will happily soak up attention from everyone she meets. She suits a semi-active lifestyle, enjoying her outings and playtime while still appreciating downtime at home. Fawn is used to being handled by children, making her a great choice for a family with kids of all ages. Fawn is small-dog and cat workable and would be perfectly happy as a solo dog or living alongside another furry friend. With her friendly nature and adaptable personality, Fawn is ready to slot easily into a wide range of loving homes. If you’re looking for a confident, social greyhound with lots of character, Fawn could be the perfect addition to your family. 🐾

NAME: Coco
TEXT: Coco is a beautiful girl who has the perfect mix of playful energy and laid-back charm. She loves human company and enjoys being part of the action with her people. Coco has a semi-active lifestyle — she adores playing with toys and doing zoomies, but she’s just as happy chilling out and relaxing once she’s had her fun. Because she can be a little excitable, Coco would be best suited as a family dog with older children. She is small-dog workable, depending on the breed, and will thrive in a home that understands her playful nature while giving her plenty of affection and downtime. If you’re looking for a fun-loving greyhound who enjoys both playtime and cuddle time, Coco could be the perfect fit. 🐾

NAME: Louie
TEXT: Louie is a happy boy who strikes the perfect balance between playful and laid-back. He loves zoomies and playing with toys, but he’s just as content relaxing and doing his own thing when it’s time to unwind. Louie is food motivated, which makes him a fun and rewarding boy to work with. He’s small-dog workable and enjoys human connection, while also being perfectly fine spending time independently. Due to his enthusiastic spirit, Louie would be best suited to a family with older children. A semi-active lifestyle will suit Louie well — one that includes playtime, daily outings, and plenty of chill time at home. If you’re looking for a greyhound with a great mix of fun and flexibility, Louie could be a wonderful addition to your family. 🐾

NAME: Chunky
TEXT: Chunky is a happy girl with a constant smile and a never-ending wagging tail. She absolutely thrives on human connection and will happily be your little shadow, following you wherever you go. She suits a semi-active lifestyle — Chunky loves playing with toys and doing zoomies, but once she’s had her fun, she’s more than content to curl up inside as a true couch potato. Because she can be quite excitable, a family with older children would be the best fit for her. Chunky is small-dog workable and may be cat workable with a slow, careful introduction. She’s looking for a home where she can share plenty of affection, playtime, and cosy downtime with her people. If you’re after a joyful, affectionate greyhound who brings smiles wherever she goes, Chunky could be the one for you. 🐾

NAME: Kozi
TEXT: Kozi is a happy, affectionate boy who loves spending time with his people — but he’s also quite content enjoying his own company. He’s a well-balanced greyhound who knows how to switch between playtime and relaxation. Kozi is small-dog workable and has had some exposure to the dashy on the property, showing positive signs with appropriate management. Due to his size, Kozi would be best suited to a family with older children. An active lifestyle will suit Kozi well, and a secure yard is a must so he can enjoy his favourite zoomies. He would be very happy living with another dog, making him a great companion for an existing canine friend. If you’re looking for a fun-loving greyhound who enjoys both affection and independence, Kozi could be your perfect match. 🐾

NAME: Bindie
TEXT: Don’t let Bindie’s size fool you — she’s a gentle soul at heart who truly thrives on human connection. Bindie loves being close to her people and would make a wonderful work-from-home companion, happily keeping you company throughout the day. She is small-dog workable and may be cat workable with a slow, sensible introduction. Bindie could also suit apartment living, provided she gets out for daily walks and enrichment. She enjoys a semi-active lifestyle, balancing outings with plenty of downtime. Bindie has been handled by children around 12 years old and has had some exposure to the dashy on her property, showing she can adapt well with the right guidance. She may thrive in a home with another dog or with a family looking for a calm, affectionate companion. If you’re looking for a loving, loyal greyhound who just wants to be near her people, Bindie might be the perfect match. 🐾

NAME: Sissy
TEXT: Meet Sissy 🌸 Sissy is a social, friendly girl with a big heart and an even bigger love for people. She adores playtime, daily walks, and soaking up pats and cuddles, especially from her much-loved grandchildren aged 4 to 14 years. She’s a pleasure to walk on lead and happily strolls around the local school and shops, taking everything in her stride and not worried about passing other dogs and people. Affectionate and people-focused, Sissy loves being inside with her family and would be perfectly content claiming a spot on the lounge as her own! After a walk and some play, she’s just as happy to relax indoors or outdoors, and she enjoys cooling off with a splash in her clam shell pool. Sissy is wonderfully easy-going, enjoys car rides, and even cheerfully visits the vet as a blood donor. She’s a loving companion who would make a wonderful family pet and a loyal friend for anyone. 🐾💖

NAME: Selena
TEXT: Meet Selena 💕 Selena is a sweet, friendly, and playful girl who’s ready to charm her way into your heart. She absolutely loves pats and cuddles and enjoys spending quality time with her people, whether that’s relaxing indoors or heading out on a car ride adventure. Selena is a dream to walk on lead and is confident around traffic and other dogs she meets along the way. She’s social and playful, happily sharing backyard fun with her Jack Russell and Whippet friends, as well as male greyhounds. At home, you’ll often find her playing with her favourite rope toys or cooling off with a splash in her shell pool. Easy-going and easy to care for, Selena would thrive in a home that offers her a daily walk or backyard play, time inside with her people, and plenty of love. She’s a gentle, loyal girl who’s ready to become a devoted companion and have a home to call her own. 🐾

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: Meet Teddy 🐾 Teddy is an easy-going, friendly boy with the gentlest nature. He’s a true delight to have in the home and loves everyone he meets. Teddy is wonderful with other dogs of all sizes - from a Jack Russell to a Labrador and any dog he meets - and he’s also great with children, happily spending time and getting pats from kids aged 5 and 8, even good with the household cats. This lovely boy is both house-trained and crate-trained, walks beautifully on lead, and is no trouble on street walks. He’s not overactive and is very relaxed - once he’s home, Teddy is more than happy to settle in and rest. On warm days, Teddy enjoys a bit of fun with water. Whether it’s splashing in a shell pool, sitting under the sprinkler, or even enjoying a swim in a river or dam, water time always brings out his happy side. Teddy is a gentle soul who would make a wonderful, easy-care, and loving companion for most households. If you’re looking for a calm, affectionate dog who fits right into family life, Teddy could be your perfect match. 💛🐶

NAME: Meteor
TEXT: Meet Meteor — a handsome five-year-old fawn greyhound with a joyful outlook on life and a temperament that makes him a pleasure to be around. Energetic, enthusiastic, and always ready to get going, Meteor loves his daily walks and brings a sense of fun and purpose to everything he does. He has a real passion for toys and playtime, and his love of food makes him a rewarding companion for ongoing training and enrichment at home. Meteor is very friendly with people and enjoys being part of an active household where he can engage, explore, and then settle comfortably once his needs are met. He would best suit a home with a secure backyard where he can stretch his legs and enjoy some off-duty fun, and a family with older children who can match his energy and enthusiasm. When out and about, Meteor has shown good sociability on lead, calmly walking alongside dogs of all sizes and presenting as a dog who is likely to continue doing well with other animals, given appropriate introductions. If you’re looking for a confident, playful greyhound who will bring warmth, personality, and plenty of joy into your home life, Meteor could be the perfect match.

NAME: Ace
TEXT: Ace is a handsome black male greyhound who may be a little shy at first, but with a few gentle cuddles and some reassurance, he quickly comes out of his shell. Once settled, his sweet and affectionate nature really shines. Ace walks beautifully on lead, making daily outings calm and enjoyable. He also has a playful side and loves spending time with his toys, happily entertaining himself or joining in for a game. He’s a well-mannered boy around other dogs and is good with larger breed dogs. A big plus is Ace’s excellent disengagement skills, making him small-dog and cat workable with appropriate introductions and management. His thoughtful, responsive nature shows just how well he listens and adapts to his environment. Ace would thrive in a patient, loving home that understands he just needs a little time to feel safe—once he does, you’ll be rewarded with a loyal, cuddly companion. If you’re looking for a gentle greyhound who blossoms with kindness and affection, Ace could be your perfect match 🐾

NAME: Benson
TEXT: Benson is a handsome fawn male greyhound with a truly gentle soul and a naturally quiet nature. Soft, sweet, and understated, he’s the kind of companion who brings a sense of calm wherever he goes. He would be best suited to a quiet, relaxed lifestyle and would fit nicely into a home with older children who can appreciate and respect his gentle temperament. Benson could live happily as a solo dog, but he may also benefit from having a canine friend, as he enjoys calm company. Benson should be comfortable in a full-time worker household, provided his needs are met and he has a peaceful environment to return to. A wonderful bonus is that he is small-dog and cat workable, making him a great option for multi-pet homes. If you’re looking for a sweet, low-key greyhound who thrives in a calm home and offers quiet companionship, Benson could be the perfect match 🐾

NAME: Mouse
TEXT: Mouse is a beautiful black female greyhound with a truly gentle soul. Sweet-natured and kind, she’s the sort of girl who quietly wins hearts just by being herself. She’s comfortable around children, making her a lovely option for families, and she strikes a wonderful balance between playful and relaxed—happy to enjoy a bit of fun, then settle in for some well-earned rest. Mouse would suit a semi-active lifestyle and adapts well to a full-time worker household once she’s settled. One of Mouse’s standout qualities is her experience living with other animals. She is cat and small-dog workable, and while she can absolutely be a solo dog, having a canine friend could be a bonus, as she’s used to sharing her space with multiple pets. Mouse is a calm, affectionate companion who would thrive in a loving home that appreciates her gentle nature and quiet charm. If you’re looking for a sweet, adaptable greyhound who fits beautifully into a variety of homes, Mouse may be the perfect match 💛

NAME: Booboo
TEXT: Booboo is a handsome black male greyhound with a confident nature and a big love for comfort. One of his favourite pastimes is relaxing on a nice cozy bed, but don’t let that fool you—he’s also a very playful boy who enjoys having fun before happily settling back down. He’s best suited to a semi-active lifestyle and would fit in well with a family with older children who can respect his space. Booboo could also be workable with medium to large breed dogs with appropriate introductions. He’s comfortable with a full-time worker household, as he’s content chilling at home once his needs are met. Booboo is food motivated, which makes training and bonding an enjoyable experience. While confident in general, he can become frightened during thunder storms and would benefit from a calm home that can offer reassurance and a safe, cozy place to retreat during noisy weather. Due to his prey drive, Booboo is not suitable to live with small dogs or cats. If you’re looking for a playful yet relaxed companion who loves his comforts and enjoys being part of a calm, structured home, Booboo could be the perfect addition 🖤

NAME: Nosey
TEXT: Nosey is a gorgeous black greyhound with a big heart and a happy-go-lucky personality. He’s a confident, cheerful boy who brings a lovely balance of playful energy and laid-back chill to everyday life. Suited to a semi-active lifestyle, Nosey enjoys his walks and playtime but is just as content relaxing at home. He’s confident on lead, making outings easy and enjoyable, and he absolutely loves his toys. Add food into the mix and you’ve got his full attention—Nosey is very food motivated, which makes training a breeze. Nosey would do well with a full-time worker or as a solo dog, as he’s comfortable spending time on his own once settled. He’s adaptable and would suit a variety of adopters looking for a friendly, easygoing companion. Due to his prey drive, Nosey is not suited to living with smaller dogs or cats, but he more than makes up for it with his affectionate nature and joyful spirit. If you’re looking for a confident, fun-loving greyhound who knows how to switch between play mode and relaxation, Nosey might just be your perfect match 💛

NAME: Candy
TEXT: Candy is a cuddly, affectionate little girl who truly adores people and thrives on human attention. She’s wonderful with kids (great with children aged 10 and 13) and is always happy to be included in family life. Indoors, Candy is calm, gentle, and inquisitive, making her a lovely companion around the house. She’s very approachable, responds well to her name, and is easy to walk, which makes outings a pleasure. Candy enjoys playtime in the yard and happily plays alongside a Boxer, but people are her absolute favorite. After a burst of energy, she’s quite content to relax and lounge around—she’s a bit of a lazy girl at heart! Candy is low-maintenance and easy to care for. After walks or playtime, she’s happy to settle down for a nap, and toys keep her happily occupied if you need to head out. With her loving nature, gentle personality, and easygoing temperament, Candy would make a wonderful, devoted family pet or companion. 💕

NAME: Hudson
TEXT: Hudson is a striking black male Greyhound looking for a home that matches his fun yet easygoing nature. Best suited to a semi-active lifestyle, Hudson enjoys having space for zoomies and would love a secure backyard where he can stretch his long legs and play fetch — one of his favourite games. Due to his size, Hudson would be happiest in a family with older children. He’s confident and independent enough to be perfectly content as a solo dog, but he’d also be quite happy sharing his home with another canine companion. Hudson is small-dog workable and may be cat workable with a very slow, careful introduction and ongoing management. Hudson is comfortable being left alone for reasonable periods and settles well, making him a great match for a variety of households.

NAME: Pablo
TEXT: Pablo is a handsome black male Greyhound with a calm, gentle nature and beautifully relaxed body language. He walks well on lead, taking everything in his stride with patience and ease, making him a pleasure to spend time with both out and about and at home. Friendly and engaging, Pablo enjoys human company and happily joins in for a game of fetch, but he’s just as content to relax independently when things are quiet. He’s in great body condition and carries himself with an easygoing confidence that makes him a lovely companion. With the correct introductions and guidance, Pablo may be cat workable. He would suit a home looking for a well-balanced Greyhound who offers the best of both worlds — playful when invited, calm when it’s time to unwind.

NAME: Frankie
TEXT: Frankie is a handsome fawn male Greyhound with a lovely balance of calm and playfulness. He’s great with other Greyhounds and walks beautifully on a loose lead, making outings relaxed and enjoyable. While he’s generally placid and easygoing, Frankie also loves a good zoom around when the mood strikes — showing off his fun, playful side. Frankie is engaging and confident with people, enjoying attention and companionship without being over-the-top. He’s cat and small-dog workable, with the right introductions and management, and would be well suited to a semi-active lifestyle. Whether it’s a gentle stroll, a quick burst of play, or lounging at home, Frankie is happy to fit in.

NAME: Sally
TEXT: Meet Sally – a sweetheart looking for her forever home 🐶💖 Sally is an outgoing, friendly, and affectionate girl with a truly lovely nature. She’s gentle and respectful around children aged 6+, gets along well with small dogs (Mini Groodle and Kelpie cross), and has happily ignored the household cat (after slow introductions). Sally enjoys getting out and about and walks nicely on the lead once she gets going. She has short bursts of playful energy followed by a calm, relaxed side that loves to settle. At home, she adores her soft toys and is happiest when she can snuggle up inside with her people. Sally would be a wonderful match for an active family or a couple who enjoy spending time together and can give her the love and attention she thrives on. She’s a sweet companion who wants nothing more than to be part of your world. 🐾💕

NAME: Arna
TEXT: *Arna is in a foster care home in a unit/apartment with a Borzoi* Arna is a shy girl looking for a calm and nurturing family. She doesn't mind if her family go to work during the day, as she likes the opportunity to have some peace and quiet, and would make a lovely companion for a gentle, homebody family. Once she warms up she loves all things food and play, and will show off her brave side! A home without kids is best suited. A home with a yard/a spacious unit apartment with some space for her to retreat to when she needs to is best suited. Meet Arna at Western Sydney.

NAME: Yola
TEXT: *Yola has spent time in foster care over Xmas - update below!* "Very loving Loves the car will settle in car straight away sleeps like a log She loves her walks Over the time I had her she wasn't aggressive with her food, bed or toys She needs lots of love and affection She loves people and was super friendly with everyone she met She will make someone a very loyal loving companion We all loved her to bits" Yola is a gentle, thoughtful girl who is learning how to enjoy the comforts of pet life. Indoors, she has a lovely ability to settle for longer periods and truly appreciates a calm, cosy home environment where she can relax and feel safe. With the right guidance and understanding, she has the potential to work up to full-time hours, especially if her adopters are willing to help her ease into being left and set her up for success. Yola would thrive best in a low dog-populated area, where she can enjoy peaceful walks without feeling overwhelmed. She knows how to use stairs confidently and navigates the home environment well. While Yola can be social with other medium to large dogs, she would prefer to be the only dog in the household, where she can soak up all the love and attention. She would be best suited to a home without children, or with older, calm, and respectful children who understand how to give her space. Yola is looking for a patient, kind adopter who understands that settling into pet life is a journey and who will be rewarded with a loyal companion who truly appreciates a quiet, loving home.

NAME: George
TEXT: Handsome blue boy George is looking for a new best friend! George is an outgoing and friendly boy who just loves every single person he meets including strangers on walks! He is looking for a chilled out home and lifestyle so he can properly enjoy his retirement. A quiet house with a yard with a big comfy bed without other pets or kids to call his own is exactly what he is dreaming of. He doesn't mind spending time alone during the day making him a great match for those who work full-time hours. As long as he has a comfy bed and some yummy enrichment activities, he is happy! George loves his food and is extremely trainable - he has already mastered several cues including "down", "shake", "off" and more! This clever boy is a quick study. If you'd like to meet this one-of-a-kind boy, apply online today! George is available from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jake
TEXT: ** I am currently in a foster home with small dogs, stay tuned for more updates** Hey, I'm Jake! I'm a lovely and friendly boy, who gets along great with other greyhounds, happy settled alone in a crate, not to mention I'm food motivated which everyone says here at the centre makes it easy for me to learn "pet skills"! I am polite with other dogs on walks including the little dogs I see around, making me suitable for urban life. I would also be suitable in an apartment with lift access. I think I'm the perfect match for a family with children with busy lifestyles as I'm an easy going boy who takes it all in my stride! Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Rambo
TEXT: Rambo has enjoyed his stint in foster care, his favourite hobbies include napping on the floor, asking for cuddles (and cheese), and of course exploring the neighbourhood on his daily walks. Having lived in a foster care home, he now has his ‘stairs license’ and can confidently climb several floors. Rambo has a lot of love to give, and would therefore thrive in a calm environment. While he’s very obedient and respectful, Rambo is still working on his skills of independence and improving his confidence when being left alone for longer periods of time. He would enjoy a home with a laid back type of life. Known to roach and chill out, Rambo would be an amazing addition for a laid back couple, retirees due to his gentle nature, or a work from home lifestyle, as long as he gets a couple of short toilet walks around the block. Rambo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Solly
TEXT: Solly is a striking young man with a personality that’s equal parts energetic and laid-back. He thrives on an active lifestyle—think brisk walks, playtime, and the occasional burst of zoomies to burn off his youthful energy. After he’s had his exercise, Solly transforms into a mellow cuddle enthusiast, always ready to relax with a wagging tail and plenty of affection. Although Solly hasn’t had much experience around small dogs or cats, he didn’t seem phased by our meta cat during his visit, which is a promising sign. With a slow and careful introduction, he could comfortably live with smaller pets. His gentle nature would likely fit well into a family environment, and he also might be suited for homes with full-time workers as long as he gets his daily dose of activity. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who can keep up on walks and then happily settle down for some quality downtime, Solly might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Tyson
TEXT: Meet Tyson 🐾 Tyson is a handsome boy who would suit a semi-active lifestyle, enjoying a nice balance of daily walks, relaxed playtime, and plenty of downtime. He’s adaptable and easy going, making him a wonderful companion for a variety of households. He may do best with another doggo friend, as he enjoys canine company and would love a buddy to share his days with. Tyson is used to being around kids and is comfortable in a family environment, taking all the activity in stride. A true people-lover, Tyson is more than happy to receive lots of cuddles and affection. He settles quickly into new surroundings and takes changes in his stride, making the transition into a new home smooth and stress-free. If you’re looking for a friendly, affectionate greyhound who fits easily into family life and enjoys both activity and relaxation, Tyson could be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Rosey
TEXT: Meet Rosey 🌸 Rosey is a sweet girl who would thrive in a quiet, calm household where she can feel safe and settled. She would prefer to be the only dog in the home, allowing her to relax and enjoy being the centre of attention at her own pace. While Rosey may take a little time to come out of her shell, patience is beautifully rewarded. Once she gets to know you, she reveals her affectionate side and enjoys gentle cuddles and close companionship. Beneath her soft nature is a dog with so much love to give. Rosey would be well suited as a family dog, especially with a household that understands the value of giving her time, space, and kindness as she settles in. In return, she’ll offer loyalty, warmth, and a quiet but deeply loving presence. If you’re looking for a calm, devoted companion and are happy to let a special bond grow naturally, Rosey could be the perfect match. 💕

NAME: Will
TEXT: Meet Will 🐾 Will is a beautiful boy with a truly gentle soul. He’s the kind of dog who wins hearts quietly, with his calm presence and loving nature. Will enjoys a quick burst of fun—a happy zoomie or two—before settling in for a long, well-earned rest. He would be best suited to a quiet household where he can relax and feel at ease, and he’d do well with older children who understand and respect his gentle temperament. Will is comfortable around medium to large dogs and would happily share his home with another calm canine companion. Above all else, Will loves affection. Pats, cuddles, and kind attention are his absolute favourite, and he’ll soak them up with gratitude and a wagging tail. If you’re looking for a sweet, low-key greyhound who enjoys life’s simple pleasures and offers endless affection in return, Will could be the perfect fit. 💙

NAME: Poppy
TEXT: *I have just gone to a foster home - check in soon for updates!* Poppy is a playful, sweet girl with a heart full of love and a spring in her step. She enjoys playtime and has been friendly with the dogs she’s met. While Poppy has been nice to small dogs whilst in our care, she can be quite exuberant and so dogs over 10kg are more her style. Once Poppy gets to know you she becomes wonderfully affectionate and fun. Poppy loves exploring the world and would be thrilled to have a walking buddy by her side. Poppy would do best in a home that gives her a bit of time to settle in, then rewards you with cuddles, companionship, and lots of happy tail wags. If you’re looking for a playful, loving dog, Poppy might just be your perfect match. 🐾

NAME: Pizza
TEXT: Pizza is a confident, happy-go-lucky boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. He’s fantastic with all dogs and currently lives comfortably alongside other greyhounds, making him a great choice for a home with existing canine companions. Playful and full of life, Pizza loves to have fun and enjoys his adventures—especially when they involve travelling and exploring new places. Whether it’s a car ride, a day out, or just playtime at home, he’s always ready to be part of the action. When Pizza isn’t busy playing, he’s busy loving. He’s incredibly affectionate and well known for standing right over you, politely (or not so politely!) demanding cuddles and attention. Personal space isn’t really his thing—he’d much rather be close to his people. If you’re looking for a confident, social, and loving greyhound who will keep you smiling and ensure you never miss out on a cuddle, Pizza might just be your perfect match. 💙🐾

NAME: Maizie
TEXT: Meet Maizie 🐾💖 Maizie is a lively, playful greyhound bursting with energy and personality! She’d thrive in a home with a secure yard where she can stretch her legs, zoom to her heart’s content, and enjoy the great outdoors. A confident canine companion would be the perfect match for Maizie – she loves the company of other dogs and enjoys having a buddy by her side. With her fun-loving nature, Maizie is best suited to a home with older children who can keep up with her zest for life. She absolutely lives for treats, adores affection, and isn’t shy about handing out face licks as her signature love language! If you’re looking for a smart, affectionate greyhound who’s full of beans and full of love, Maizie is ready to join your family and brighten your days (and maybe even steal your heart…)

NAME: Blue
TEXT: Blue is a confident, character-filled greyhound who knows exactly who he is. He’s social without being over-the-top, loves a good cuddle, and then happily wanders off to do his own thing. Blue walks nicely on lead and takes everything in his stride, making him an easy and enjoyable companion. With his quietly quirky charm and laid-back independence, Blue could be well suited to a home with another large dog for company or a family who appreciates a dog with personality and balance.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a very social, affectionate greyhound with a big personality and an even bigger heart. He loves cuddles, enjoys playing with his toys, and has an endearing habit of carrying his food bowl around once he’s finished eating. Jimmy would thrive in a home with another large dog to keep him company and would benefit from having a yard to enjoy doing showing off his zoomies. Cheeky in the most lovable way, Jimmy brings fun, warmth, and plenty of smiles to those around him.

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: Teddy is a happy, affectionate greyhound who would thrive in an active home that enjoys getting out and about. He loves his zoomies just as much as his cuddles and will reward you with plenty of enthusiastic tail wags. Teddy would be best suited as a solo dog, as he prefers to keep his food and toys to himself. He’d make a wonderful companion for a family with older children who can match his energy and also appreciate his affectionate side.

NAME: Belle
TEXT: Belle is a super sweet, gentle greyhound with a relaxed and affectionate nature. She would suit a quiet lifestyle and could happily live in an apartment, as she’s more of a homebody than a high-energy dog. Belle would make a lovely family companion for homes with older children and could potentially live with a calm, medium to large dog. True to her breed, she’s a champion couch potato who loves lounging, short strolls, and soaking up affection.

NAME: Milla
TEXT: Milla is a happy, easy-going girl with a gentle soul and a truly lovely nature. She’d be a wonderful match for a relaxed family or a couple looking for a calm, well-mannered companion. Milla is great with kids aged 9+ and enjoys peaceful walks around the streets or to the park—she’s easy on the lead and not overactive. She gets along well with medium dogs like Labradors and other greyhounds, preferring male over females. That said, Milla would be happiest as the only dog in the home, where she can soak up all the love. Milla is housetrained and good inside but prefers to be mostly outside during the day, playing in her shell pool, under the sprinkler and enjoying her toys, especially on warm days. She’s also a good traveller and is always up for adventures with her people. If you’re looking for a gentle, well-balanced dog with a sweet personality and calm energy, Milla might be the perfect addition to your life. 💕

NAME: Wren
TEXT: Wren is a gentle, sweet-natured girl who can be a bit shy at first, but once she's met you and let her come to you, her affectionate personality shines through. A few treats and a little chat go a long way with this lovely lady! She loves her morning zoomies and playtime with her retired greyhound friends, then settles in for some chill time with the family – including a small mixed-breed, a whippet, a Jack Russell, and three older greyhounds. She's well-behaved indoors and enjoys being part of the daily routine, including playing with a 2 year old girl. Wren walks beautifully on the lead and is calm and confident around town. She’s a happy, social girl who loves a gentle pat and attention. On the farm she does not worry about cows and horses nearby. Wren would make a wonderful companion in a variety of homes. She’d be happy as an only dog with someone who’s home often or works part-time from home. She’d also be delighted to share her home with a small, friendly dog, especially a whippet, and loves to lie on the lounge. If you're looking for a loyal, gentle, and loving new friend, Wren could be the perfect match for you! 💝

NAME: Simba
TEXT: Beautiful boy Simba is looking for a pride of his own! Simba is a sweet and gentle 3-year-old boy with a surprising playful streak that occasionally comes out when you least expect it! He is very affectionate with people, walks well on the lead and LOVES his treaties! Simba is friendly and social with both large and small dogs, and would be a good fit for a home with another dog/s or someone looking for a dog-social companion to take out and about. As a single dog, Simba has potential to slowly work up to longer hours alone. He is well behaved indoors but as he is still getting used to pet life he would also love a small outdoor space to explore and relax in. Simba's gentle nature makes him suitable for respectful kids as long as they are able to give him space when he needs a break. So if Simba makes your hear roar, apply to adopt him today! He is available from our Western Sydney kennels.

NAME: Slim
TEXT: Meet Slim! Slim is a young greyhound who has decided that the pet life is definitely for him. As a young dog, he will benefit from some ongoing training and guidance, and he is a strong, active boy who will enjoy regular exercise and mental stimulation. Slim has met small dogs and has been polite and friendly in his interactions. He has adorable lopsided ears, which certainly don’t stop him from hearing the crinkle of a biscuit packet or the jingle of a treat pouch. Slim is a real stickybeak who loves to be involved in whatever is happening around him and enjoys being part of the action. With the right home willing to invest time in his training and include him in daily life, Slim will make a fun and rewarding companion.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Charlie is a friendly, playful, and affectionate male greyhound who enjoys being part of everyday life. He loves cooling off with a paddle in the pool on warm days and is always happy to jump in the car for an outing. Charlie thrives on spending time with his people and would suit a family who can include him in adventures, playtime, and fun activities. Charlie walks very well on a lead and is calm and reliable when out and about. He has confidently been walked by children aged nine years and older, making him a lovely option for a family with older kids. With his easy-going nature and love of companionship, Charlie would make a wonderful addition to the right home.

NAME: Sandy
TEXT: Meet Sandy 🐾 Sandy is a young female greyhound with a happy, active personality and a playful spirit. She is full of enthusiasm and would thrive in a home that enjoys spending time with her and helping her learn the basics of everyday life. Sandy would benefit from a family who are happy to put time into some gentle training and guidance. She is eager, playful, and would love a companion who will engage with her, play games, and help her build confidence as she learns life’s basics. With patience, consistency, and plenty of affection, Sandy will grow into a wonderful and rewarding companion for an active and caring home.

NAME: Tessa
TEXT: **Tessa is available via a foster care arrangement at Western Sydney - if you think you're a perfect match to foster and look after our special girl Tessa please reach out to Western Sydney** The Western Sydney team are delighted to put forward Tessa as a suitable greyhound for the right foster care home. Tessa has been our office dog here at the adoption centre. Tessa's perfect home is a home with no children, no stairs, and a house with a backyard. When it comes to other pets, Tessa has shown sociability with cats and small dogs so a home with polite existing pets could be an option pending a discussion with the rehoming team. Tessa is a very affectionate and loving girl who loves to ask for lots of pats then settle herself nice and comfy in her bed next to you. She is playful, polite, and dorky when she plays with toys! She is happy spending the day alone and would suit longer stints of hours alone. When Tessa was our beloved office dog, she was known to enjoy spending quiet time indoors snuggled up on her bed, for almost all day, sometimes you'd forget she was there! Enrichment activities such Licky-Mats and Kongs are a hit with Tessa and are a great way to bond with her. Tessa is a stunning girl looking for a family to foster her and provide her the care she needs - could it be you?

NAME: Bobby
TEXT: Meet Bobby! Bobby is a stunning black greyhound with a gentle soul and a heart full of love. This handsome boy is friendly and easygoing, making him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a loyal friend. Booby is a happy go lucky chap. He enjoys life’s simple pleasures—paddling in water on a sunny day, hopping in the car for a drive, and spending time with his furry friends. Bobby currently shares his home with a cheeky little dachshund and gets along beautifully. He’s also a social butterfly when it comes to other dogs, loving every opportunity to mingle and make new pals. Quiet and tidy in his space, Bobby is as low-maintenance as he is charming. If you’re looking for a sweet, sociable greyhound who will bring joy and calm to your life, Bobby is ready to steal your heart.

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Gus is a sweet and charming guy who has short bursts of energy, can be a little shy, with an overall adorably friendly nature. He is polite on the lead and walks perfectly next to you on adventures. He will keep his diary full of fun things like snoozing, adventures like sniffing the yard, playing with the kids, and snoozing on the couch. This sweet guy is friendly around medium to large dogs, enjoys a quick game of fetch, and is gentle, friendly and soft with all he meets. Gus is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Ella
TEXT: Ella has grown up around small dogs like poodles/cavoodles, and would suit a home with another dog big or small. She gets along with greyhounds too, making her a great fit for a multi-dog home or someone looking to take her to family events with other dogs. She can be nervous when she is first getting to know you but warms up and shows her loving personality in no time. She loves a clam shell pool in the summer time, so a house with a backyard with room for her own kiddy pool would be great this Summer! She has been described as playful, placid and calm. Ella is fond of toys and balls and will love a fun active lifestyle with her new family.

NAME: Minnie
TEXT: Minnie is a sweet, bubbly girl. Minnie is friendly, affectionate, a tad goofy, and oh so lovable! Minnie is a great blend of silly and calm, being middle aged she's ready to kick off her lounge lizard era, and can't wait to meet you! A home with a yard to perfect her zoomies, and some children to entertain her after school, would be a great fit. In return Minnie promises to keep everyone upbeat and having fun every day. She can be nervous in new places so a family who are happy to take it slow to begin with would be a great fit. This gorgeous girl can be adopted at Western Sydney.

NAME: Girl
TEXT: Hi, I'm Girl! I'm young, cute, and looking for a new family. I can be shy in new places but I promise to be a big brave girl once I become a member of your family. Due to being a bit nervous, older children would be best suited for me. A home with a place to retreat would be the best, as I learn to thrive along side you, so a house with a yard or my own room would be really great! I am friendly with other dogs and show a cute little tail wag, showing off my brave side. I'm still young so a family who can train me and teach me all about the world would be amazing! Meet me by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Tanooki
TEXT: Hey! I'm Tanooki. I'm a friendly, outgoing guy looking for a place to call home. I am affectionate, love zoomies, and would make an awesome addition for a family with fun loving children who are looking for an energetic pal. I am friendly with big and small dogs and would suit a home with a likeminded doggie pal. If you have a backyard, love the fun life and are looking for a cool guy like me, apply now! I'm available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Diva
TEXT: Diva is a stunning female greyhound who knows what she loves: food, attention, and plenty of affection! She walks beautifully on a loose lead, making strolls with her an absolute pleasure. This affectionate girl adores being the centre of attention and will happily soak up all the love you can give. Diva would prefer a calm, medium-to-large doggy friend to share her space—she’s not really a fan of the cute little dogs. If you’re looking for a sweet, loving companion who will melt your heart (and maybe sneak a snack or two), Diva is ready to rule your world!

NAME: Crackers
TEXT: Meet Crackers – and no, she’s not crackers at all! Crackers is a gorgeous greyhound with a sweet and curious personality. She’s usually calm and quiet, but she loves to be involved and keep an eye on what’s going on—she’s a bit of a sticky beak! She’s great with small dogs, adores a good pat, and is super easy to handle and walk. Crackers is the kind of girl who will happily join you for a stroll, then curl up for some well-deserved cuddles. If you’re looking for a gentle, friendly greyhound who’s just the right mix of chilled and cheeky, Crackers is ready to steal your heart! “Crackers – the calm, curious companion you’ve been waiting for!”

NAME: Derek
TEXT: Hi, I'm Derek! I'm a friendly, food motivated boy who loves treats and I have even learnt things like "yes" and "down". I am great in a crate, and enjoy my apartment simulation times making me suitable to be indoors with you during the day. I would like to live in a house with a backyard and I'm even suitable for full time workers. Sometimes the big wide world can get a bit overwhelming so a bit of encouragement on walks and a slow exposure to new things would be really good for me! A home without children and staircases is ideal. Come meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Poet
TEXT: *I'm in foster care - see update below!* "He has settled in really well, he is very independent and is happy to just watch you walk around the house, definitely not a velcro dog. He is walking really good on the lead also, is not distracted by noises or other dogs." I’m Poet the greyhound, long legs, gentle soul, A champion napper with couch-warming goals. I’m living in foster, I’ve learned all the rules, Including toilet training — I’m no fool. Full-time workers, you’re speaking my style, I’ll greet you at home with a long-legged smile. I walk, I nap, I play with flair, Mostly I’m calm and happy to share. So if you’re seeking a calm, loyal friend, A story of love with a beautiful end, Come meet me soon, my chapter’s not through, I’m Poet, and I’m waiting just for you. Poet is available from Western Sydney.

NAME: Bandit
TEXT: Meet Bandit Bandit is a handsome male greyhound with a heart as big as his soulful eyes. He’s a quiet and easy-going boy who loves a calm environment. While he may be a little shy at first, Bandit quickly warms up and shows his sweet, affectionate nature. He’s great with small dogs and knows how to share his space politely. Bandit is also polite and well-mannered with children and has been around kids aged 7 and under, making him a wonderful family companion. A clean and tidy housemate, Bandit uses a doggie door like a pro, making him low-maintenance and independent. If you’re looking for a gentle soul who will bring peace and companionship to your home, Bandit is ready to steal your heart.

NAME: Willow
TEXT: Meet Willow 🌸 Willow is a friendly, happy older girl with a gentle soul and lots of love to give. She’s had two litters in the past and plenty of handling, so she’s calm, confident, and very people-oriented. Willow is affectionate and enjoys being around her humans — she’ll happily come up to you for pats and cuddles, and loves spending time with you in the backyard or joining you on relaxed walks. She gets along with other dogs and would suit a quiet household with some attention and walks, happy with grandchildren visiting aged 6 and up. Not overly energetic, Willow is an easy-care companion who’s content just being near you and sharing your day. If you’re looking for a sweet, steady friend with a loving nature, Willow could be the perfect addition to your household. 🐾💛

NAME: Tom
TEXT: Tom is a handsome male greyhound with a heart as big as his graceful stride. He’s the perfect mix of calm and friendly. Personality: Tom is clean, quiet, and wonderfully easy-going. He loves a peaceful environment and is happiest when he can relax by your side. Temperament: Calm and affectionate, Tom enjoys gentle company and is friendly with small dogs, making him a great fit for multi-pet households. Why You’ll Love Him: His laid-back nature and sweet personality mean he’ll quickly become your best friend. Whether it’s a cozy evening indoors or a leisurely walk, Tom is always ready to share the moment. Don't miss out on this handsome boy, head out and check him out.

NAME: Dan
TEXT: Dan is a handsome 6-year-old male greyhound with a need for speed—he’s very fast and loves to run! When he’s not showing off his racing skills, Dan enjoys taking it easy and lazing around. He’s great with other dogs and relaxed around children, making him a wonderful companion for families. If you’re looking for a gentle, friendly boy who loves both adventure and chill time, Dan is your guy!

NAME: Dusty
TEXT: Hi, I'm Dusty, a distinguished, gentle boy looking for a couch to call my own. I am polite with other dogs and would suit a home with a calm medium-large companion - although not essential. A house with a backyard would be perfect, as I love to sniff around and enjoy the indoor outdoor lifestyle. A home who will continue training and enrichment games would be great as I am smart and have shown I'm eager to learn. A home without children is best as I can be shy around lots of stimulus. I need a home that is calm and consistent so I can build my confidence and settle in well. Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Alfie
TEXT: 💙 Meet Alfie — Your Blue Fawn Adventure Buddy! Alfie is a striking blue fawn greyhound with a bright mind and an energetic spirit. He’s eager, curious, and always ready for his next adventure — the perfect match for a family who loves to get out and explore. ✨ What Alfie is looking for: An active lifestyle: Alfie thrives with regular exercise, outings, and activities that keep both his body and mind engaged. Family home with older kids: He’d do well in a busy, loving household with children who understand dogs and enjoy being part of his fun. Canine companions: Alfie is best suited to living with a medium or large dog who can match his play style and confidence. A yard to enjoy: Space to stretch out, run, and sniff is important for this energetic boy. Lots of enrichment: Puzzle toys, training games, and new experiences help Alfie shine — he loves using his brain just as much as his legs. Alfie is ready to bring enthusiasm, affection, and excitement into the right home. If you're searching for a fun, smart companion who’ll keep life lively, Alfie could be the perfect partner for your adventures.

NAME: Snag
TEXT: Snag is a handsome blue brindle boy who would suit a house with a backyard, and a home in a low dog populated area. His ideal fit would be an owner who doesn't wish to bring Snag to high dog populated areas like dog parks, doggy day care/cafes. His ideal home would be one with a couple hours alone here and there, and a family who can build him up to more. He likes being indoors when it's hot so the ability to be indoors and outdoors is a must. This gorgeous boy would mingle nicely with children 10+. Snag is on the small size for a male greyhound, too. Snag is a gorgeous boy and we can't wait to see which lucky family gets to take him home. Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Cody
TEXT: Meet Cody – Your Gentle, Cheerful Gentleman Cody is a handsome fawn male greyhound with a loving nature and a wonderfully balanced energy level. He’s a big boy with an even bigger heart, always ready to greet the day with a joyful morning run-around. After that, he’s content to relax and spend most of the day snoozing happily. He enjoys a play session or a nice walk later in the day, making him a great match for people who like a bit of activity without constant high energy.
