Ducky would love a family with older, understanding children, and she’s suitable to live with medium to large dogs who are respectful and calm like her. If you're after a sweet companion who just wants to be loved and lounge by your side, Ducky might be your perfect match 🐾💗

NAME: Goofy
TEXT: Meet Goofy – A Special Boy Looking for His Special Home 🐶💛 Goofy is a sweet male with a quirky charm and a heart ready to bond. He’s looking for a quiet, patient home where he can take things at his own pace. Goofy needs someone who understands that dogs like him need time, gentle guidance, and a whole lot of love to build trust. He’s still learning about the world, so training and socialization will be key to helping him grow into his best self. Goofy would do best as the only dog in the home, with older, understanding children who can respect his boundaries. With the right people, Goofy will shine – could that be you?

NAME: Sofia
TEXT: Meet Sofia – A Loving Blue Beauty Looking for Her Forever Home 💙🐾 Sofia is a beautiful blue female with a gentle soul and a heart full of potential. She's looking for a home that can offer her support, understanding, and time—someone patient and committed to helping her grow with continued training and care. Sofia has an old injury to her front leg, so she’ll need a family that understands her physical needs and can help her feel safe and comfortable. She thrives best as a single dog in the household and would be happiest with older, dog-savvy children who can respect her space and needs. If you’re ready to offer a calm, loving home where Sofia can continue her journey, she’s ready to meet you. 💙

NAME: Tylah
TEXT: Tylah is a beautiful, gentle soul who’s mastered the art of relaxing. She’s a laid-back lady who loves her naps and cozy spots, but don’t let that fool you—she still has her zoomie moments! Short bursts of energy are her specialty, followed by lots of lounging and cuddles. She’s happiest when she’s with her people, always close by and ready to share her calm, loving presence. Loyal, sweet, and full of quiet charm, Tylah is the kind of companion who makes every day feel a little more peaceful. If you're looking for a loyal, low-maintenance best friend who will love being by your side (especially on the couch), Tylah might just be the perfect match. 💕

NAME: Digger
TEXT: Digger is a curious, affectionate boy who loves to learn and be involved in whatever you're doing. He’s attentive, enjoys playing with his toys, and thrives on interaction. Digger would do best as the only dog in the home and would love having older children to play and bond with.

NAME: Brad
TEXT: Brad is a lively, energetic boy once he feels at home. He enjoys playtime, especially in a backyard where he can stretch his legs and have fun. Brad is good with smaller dogs and would do well in a home with older children. A sweet, active companion ready for his next adventure!

NAME: Rafiki
TEXT: Rafiki is a lively, energetic boy with an incredible love for toys! He’s a one-dog fetch machine—happily tossing his own toys just to chase them down again. Social, interactive, and full of fun, Rafiki brings playful energy and joy wherever he goes.

NAME: Dempsey
TEXT: Dempsey is a fun-loving, affectionate boy with a big personality and an even bigger love for his toys. He's interactive, silly, and always ready to make you laugh with his goofy antics. Dempsey does well with smaller dogs after a slow, safe introduction. A joyful companion who’s all about play, cuddles, and good vibes!

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: Meet Bruce! 🖤 Bruce is a sweet, laid-back boy with a charming personality. He gets along well with small dogs and is always happy to spend time with his human friends. Bruce does have pannus, a condition that affects his eyes. While it's not curable, it’s easily managed with treatment to keep him comfortable. If you’re looking for a friendly, easy-going companion with a big heart, Bruce is ready to bring his charm into your life!

NAME: Venus
TEXT: Venus is a beautiful, independent lady who is an absolute delight to have around. She’s perfectly happy relaxing on her own but still enjoys some attention and pats when you're nearby. She’s been socialised with small dogs and, while she’s not overly interested in them, she’s calm and well-behaved in their company. If you're looking for a sweet, low-maintenance companion who enjoys both quiet time and a little love, Venus could be the one for you! She may be nearly 8 years old but she still has lots of love to share.

NAME: Vox
TEXT: Vox is a gentle, affectionate boy who’s ready to find his forever home.One filled with patience, calm, and understanding. While he can be a little reserved at first, his sweet, loving nature shines through once you get to know him. He’s now ready to take the next step and find a calm, experienced home that can continue to help him build confidence and guide him through life’s adventures. Vox thrives in a peaceful environment where he can take things at his own pace and be gently encouraged to try new experiences. Once he feels settled, Vox’s affectionate and goofy side shines through. He enjoys quiet companionship, gentle affection, and the comfort of a predictable routine. Vox would do best in a home without other dogs or children, where he can enjoy a calm, stable environment and the undivided attention of his family. He would thrive with someone who understands sensitive dogs and can offer him patience, consistency, and kindness. In the right home, this beautiful boy will continue to flourish and become a devoted, lifelong friend. If you’re looking for a gentle companion and have the time and experience to help a sweet soul like Vox grow in confidence, he could be the perfect match for you. 💛 He is available now from our Western Sydney centre.

NAME: Rowdy
TEXT: Meet Rowdy! The handsome social butterfly with a heart full of love and a nose for treats! This confident and friendly guy absolutely adores people and will charm his way into your heart (and maybe your snack stash) in no time. Rowdy is super trainable and eager to learn, especially if food or toys are involved – a home that is interested in furthering his training and development is ideal Rowdy is still learning the ropes when it comes to other animals, so he’s best suited as a solo dog or with another greyhound friend who can help him find his groove. He’d thrive in a home with a yard to explore and a family who can support him through his transition to pet life. With a little guidance and a lot of love, Rowdy will be the ultimate loyal companion – cheeky, charming, and full of fun. Rowdy is available through our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Blaze
TEXT: Meet this laid-back, placid boy—our sweet male Blaze! He's the definition of a "dopey" cuddle bug who loves nothing more than a good snuggle. As a single dog household pup, he's very content with his quiet life in the backyard, and he's happy to share his space with older children who understand his calm nature. Experienced owners will appreciate his lazy demeanor and gentle temperament. He’s all about relaxing and enjoying the simple things in life!

NAME: Bertha
TEXT: Bertha is a playful, cheeky, and energetic female greyhound who loves people and is very social. She’s curious and full of fun, always ready for an adventure. With the right introduction, she might get along with smaller dogs, making her a great addition to an active and engaging home.

NAME: Collie
TEXT: Collie is a sweet older female with a calm, relaxed, and easy-going nature. She’s happy to please and would thrive in a slower-paced home. Older children are best for her, and she’s fine with smaller dogs and cats, making her a wonderful companion for a peaceful and loving household.

NAME: Dare
TEXT: Dare is a big, gentle giant with a very sweet and playful nature. He’s fun-loving yet shows a patient and calm side when needed. Confident and happy, Dare is the perfect mix of energy and tranquility, making him an affectionate companion for any home.

NAME: Windy
TEXT: Windy is a very sweet-natured male dog who can be a little shy at first but quickly comes out of his shell, especially when playing with toys. Confident on his own, he gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs and is sure to bring joy and warmth once he settles in.

NAME: Hank
TEXT: Hank is a calm, easy-going, and very friendly dog with an affectionate and interactive nature. He loves to connect with others and is great with smaller breeds of dogs. Hank’s gentle personality makes him a wonderful companion for any home looking for a sweet and sociable pet.

NAME: Tom
TEXT: Tom is a happy boy who thrives on his own in a single-dog household. He needs a supportive home where he can grow and learn. With patience and encouragement, Tom will blossom into a loving and confident companion.

NAME: Scotch
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Scotch! 🖤 Scotch is a happy, confident greyhound with a heart full of joy. Due to a past leg injury, he enjoys a slower-paced home and shorter walks—but don’t worry, he can still move around and play just fine! 🐾 Engaging, affectionate, and full of love, Scotch thrives in a calm environment where he can relax and enjoy life at his own pace. If you're looking for a gentle, loyal companion, Scotch is ready to win your heart. 💕

NAME: Uno
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Uno! 🌟 Uno is a lovely older lady with a confident, engaging personality and a heart full of love. 💕 She’s sweet, kind, and always happy—bringing a warm, joyful presence wherever she goes. With her calm nature and affectionate spirit, Uno makes the perfect companion for a caring, loving family ready to share their home with a gentle soul. 🐶💫 If you’re looking for a steady, loving friend, Uno is ready to make your heart her home.

NAME: Dozer
TEXT: Dozer, or "Little D," is a sweet boy who needs time and patience to learn and grow. He’ll thrive in a quiet home where he can feel safe and supported as he blossoms into his best self. With the right care, he’s sure to become a loving companion.

NAME: Lexi
TEXT: Lexi is a sweet and placid female greyhound with a calm demeanor. Eager to learn, she needs room to grow and thrive, along with patience and understanding. A single-dog household would be ideal, providing her with the space and care she needs to flourish.

NAME: Aggi
TEXT: Aggi is a pretty female greyhound who can be a little shy at first. She needs encouragement, support, love, and time to grow. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can feel secure and receive the attention she needs. Aggi is eager to learn and thrive with the right care and patience.

NAME: Micha
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Micha! 💖 Micha is a sweet and sensitive female greyhound looking for a calm, loving home to help her blossom. With the right support and encouragement, she’s eager to learn and grow into a confident companion. She’ll thrive in a quiet environment where she feels safe and secure. Micha would do best as the only dog to start with, giving her the space and attention she needs to adjust and build trust. If you have a gentle heart and a peaceful home, Micha is ready to find comfort by your side. 🐶💕

NAME: Tubby
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Tubby! 💗 Tubby is a sweet girl who just needs a little time and patience to truly shine. 🌸 She can be a bit unsure at times, but with the right support and encouragement, she’ll blossom into a loving, confident companion. She’d do best in a calm, single-dog household where she can feel safe and truly be herself. With your love and guidance, Tubby is sure to thrive. 🐶💕

NAME: Sassy
TEXT: Sassy is a female greyhound looking for a quiet, supportive, and loving home. She needs room to grow, learn, and thrive, along with the encouragement and patience to help her blossom. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can receive all the attention and care she deserves.

NAME: Molly
TEXT: Molly is a sweet female greyhound who can be a little shy and unsure at first, but she’ll open up with time and patience. She needs space, encouragement, and room to grow in a supportive environment. Molly thrives in a single-dog household where she can receive the love and attention she needs to feel comfortable and secure.

NAME: Minni
TEXT: Minni is a laid-back, easy-going older gal with a calm and confident demeanor. She’s curious and independent, but also affectionate and loves a good snuggle. Minni is the perfect companion for someone looking for a relaxed and loving pet.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Lucy is a very friendly and affectionate older girl who loves to give and receive cuddles. She can be relaxed and easy-going, but also has a cheeky, playful side that adds fun to her personality. Good with smaller breeds of dogs, Lucy makes a sweet and loving companion for any home.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Beautiful Lucy is lady who needs to find a supportive, patient & kind family. Lucy shows interest in wanting to be a part of a family, grow, learn how to be confident & playful, she just needs that support & encouragement to do so. A quiet home at first would be ideal. Lucy has spent time indoors, around children & a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction & supervision, Lucy may become best friends with your smaller fluff's. Please reach out if you would like to meet Lucy :)

NAME: Red
TEXT: This is our boy Red. Say hello to this charming boy who is looking for his forever home. Red is relaxed on lead, great to handle, making your daily walks very enjoyable. He has had frequent exposure to leisurely strolls in town and enjoys the slow paced lifestyle. He is very friendly and will stop for pats or to say hello. At times Red can be apprehensive in new environments. Once he has found his feet, he takes the world in his stride and settles into a happy pace of life. He would suit a quieter home with any humans, big or small, that are willing to give him all of the love in the world.

NAME: Stacey
TEXT: Meet our sweet girl Stacey. Stacey warms up after a little bit of attention but initially she could be weary of her surroundings. She has spent time around children and is gentle around them. Stacey is responsive on lead but will like to sniff around as well.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Are you after a playful and cheeky friend? Benji is after his forever home! He is all things cheeky, confident and cunning. Benji is responsive on lead but some extra training wouldn't go astray. He loves a pat and to bound around a yard big or small, he would be suitable to live in a townhouse or villa and would in time be able to conquer stairs. Benji had an injury in 2023 which he has now recovered from but has a plate in his hock. If you're interested in learning more about Benji, please apply now.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Meet Jimmy, a laid-back and easygoing dog with a heart full of love to give. Jimmy is the perfect companion for those who appreciate a relaxed and unflustered canine friend. Jimmy is dog who adores the simple pleasures in life, from leisurely strolls in the park to quiet evenings lounging at home. He's not one to rush through life but rather takes his time to soak in his surroundings, making every moment feel special and serene. His chilled-out nature also makes him an excellent companion for other medium to large breed dogs. If you're in search of a dog who can seamlessly integrate into a tranquil lifestyle, whether you're single, a couple, or a family, Jimmy is ready to settle in and share his companionship with you. Get ready for leisurely adventures and cozy evenings with this loving and relaxed furry friend.

NAME: Paddy
TEXT: Mr Paddy! This gentle giant is such an easy-going, laid-back goof ball! He is always down to clown or just take it easy and rest his feet. He gets on well with smaller breeds of dogs- there's a Yorkie always saying hello :) Paddy interacts positively with new people, even younger children. He would love to have yard where he can run about, chasing toys thrown by his new best friends :)

NAME: Dora
TEXT: Pleased to introduce you to the wonderful Dora! Dora is a senior lady looking to share her love with a new family. Dora has spent time living with a young family for approx 12 months & is now ready to find her forever home. She loves young children. Very patient & calm with them. Dora is gentle, kind & affectionate. Engaging in sweet cuddles & kisses. Dora may adapt to living on her own or in an apartment. Confident & content, she might well adapt to full-time workers as well :)

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Looking for a sweetheart that loves children, engaging in fun play & snuggling? Then Millie is the girl for you! Millie is very excitable & playful! Loves to run around being a little silly & cheeky. Quick to jump in a body of water.... even on picture day hehe :)

NAME: Chucky
TEXT: Sweet & adorable older gal. Independant & confident. Will adpat to full time workers. Has spent time around young grandchildren. Relaxed in new spaces & around new people. Sister to Storm! Would you consider welcoming both into your family?

NAME: Garnet
TEXT: **Garnet has lived in a foster home in the city CBD with full time workers, is affectionate and intelligent, and loves long walkies and would enjoy an active family to keep fit and go on daily adventures with** She's been a joy to foster! Here's a glimpse into Garnet's wonderful traits: - Garnet is an early bird who enjoys morning naps after joining you in bed. - A fearless adventurer, she's unbothered by much and walks in loud, busy city streets. - Walks in the rain without hesitation. - Patiently waits outside shops while you run quick errands. - Curious by nature, Garnet follows you around, eager to be part of your activities. - Loves to relax and roach on the couch. - Enjoys chasing Frisbees, balls, and playing with squeaky toys. - An exceptional office companion and assistant. - Incredibly friendly and affectionate, she welcomes pats from everyone she meets. - Gentle with children she meets. - Gets super excited about snacks, especially denta sticks! - Loves to taste a variety of foods, from peanut butter, hot chips, and banana. - Garnet has accompanied professional dog walkers, who have consistently praised how well she walks on the lead. Garnet has been a delight in the home, and I'm sure she'll make an excellent addition to a loving family. We’ll certainly miss her! If you're looking for a dog to fill your home with love and joy then apply to adopt the gorgeous Garnet today!

NAME: Pattie
TEXT: Meet Pattie, a gentle and gracious senior who has spent her life expertly spreading love and warmth. Pattie has been in the company of children and copes well with if they are polite and well mannered. Pattie is a well-mannered lady who carries herself with a polite serenity, she has been socialised with small dogs and although she would prefer a large companion she is polite around small dogs. Pattie has slowed in her senior years, but she would love a foster home where she can settle and would be the perfect companion for someone looking for an older calm companion.

NAME: Eve
TEXT: Meet Eve, a gentle and calm senior lady who's ready to grace your home with her presence. With her quiet and serene nature, Eve is the epitome of tranquility, and she effortlessly brings a sense of peace wherever she roams. Eve has a friendly disposition and a soulful gaze that speaks volumes. She's an observant girl who appreciates the simpler things in life, making her a suitable match for a loving individual or family seeking a mellow furry friend. As a senior dog, Eve would thrive in a foster home where she can enjoy her golden years in comfort. Her dream environment would be one filled with love, where she can relax while being treasured as the devoted companion she is. By welcoming Eve into your life, you'll not only be providing her with a secure and loving home, but you'll also be rewarded with the companionship of a truly special and lovable friend.

NAME: Katie
TEXT: Quote from foster career, We have loved getting to know Katie and giving her the opportunity to enjoy her new life as a pet. Being the older sister, she is very independent and settles very easily. She is very happy to sit on her bed whilst you work or go about your day. She is toilet trained and has fallen into her new routine very easily. She gets so excited to see us, as exemplified with her happy, whipping tail (duck for cover!). She tends to jump up on you when she’s very excited, but this is something we are working on and have already seen great improvements on. Katie walks well on a leash and doesn’t react negatively to other dogs, big or small. She has done well approaching small dogs and children and saying hello. Katie would be a great pet for a someone looking for an independent dog that will also shower you will love and affection. __________________________________________________________________________ Katie is a lovely hound. She is happy and confident, very playful. Does appreciate a good lay down also. Has been living in a rural setting is no stranger to native animals and is now in suburban foster care enjoying cuddly toys, living out the back and coming in the home for the evening.

NAME: Flash
TEXT: **I'm in a foster home** Flash is seeking an empathetic & nurturing owner who can follow a cooperative care plan to help with his daily eye medication. Could you be the perfect owner for our sweet boy? Flash has advanced pannus, which means he needs daily eye medication. But don’t worry—he’s a star pupil when it comes to taking his meds & he’s getting better every day with the right guidance. Flash is currently learning all sorts of new tricks at the adoption centre. He is a fast learner and with a little time and practice, he's shown he can do amazing things. A large yard where Flash can stretch his legs and zoom around is a must! He loves a good run, and a big space is perfect for his energy. No small children or other animals. Flash would prefer a calm environment where he can be the only one getting your attention and affection. Flash is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. **Flash is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Meet Spot, our distinguished older gentleman who is looking for the perfect match. Spot isn't just any dog; he carries himself with the grace and ease that only a seasoned greyhound can. Spot has had the pleasure of living in the serene setting of a granny flat, making him an expert in enjoying the quieter side of life. However, don’t let his age fool you; thanks to a thorough training program, Spot is sharp and responsive. He comes eagerly when his name is called and possesses a well-mannered set of tricks, including "touch" and "paws up," that make him a delight to teach and interact with. His training, combined with his naturally loyal temperament, makes Spot an excellent fit for a single person looking for a true companion. He understands the comforting routine of a single household and offers unwavering loyalty in return. Spot embodies the best qualities of an older dog. Devoted and endearing, he is ready to join someone who values thoughtful companionship and has room in their heart for a truly dignified and loving friend.

NAME: Chandler
TEXT: Meet sweet & beautiful Chandler... Chandler is a gentle and polite male greyhound with a calm and relaxed demeanor. He’s a sweetheart who greets everyone warmly and enjoys a good snuggle, especially after a sunbath. Chandler has been around older kids and medium-sized dogs, and he gets along well with both. He’s also a joy to walk on a lead, making him the perfect companion for leisurely strolls. Whether lounging in the sun or curled up for some quiet time, Chandler is sure to bring a sense of calm and affection to any home.

NAME: Raffa
TEXT: This bundle of joy loves human interaction and adventure. Raffa loves to run around his big yard area and shows you how fast he can be. Raffa gets very excited for the first five minutes you meet him before settling down. After getting his morning energy out and jumping around Raffa settles down and loves to lay in the sun. Raffa is fine around older kids and would make a great pet for a family with a big yard or a young couple who are fit and active.

NAME: Ronald
TEXT: Ronald is a cheerful, confident and friendly lad looking to bounce straight into your home. We know Ronald to be a charismatic, charming and affectionate boy. With these qualities in mind, we think he'd suit a family with children and preferably shorter hours alone while he begins to settle in. This beautiful boy is at the magical age of 7 where he has his lazy side but has moments of playfulness, too. A perfect blend for many family types! Did we mention he currently lives with another greyhound? He'd love it if you had another hound for a play mate and nap buddy. Get in touch with the Western Sydney centre to meet Ronald.

NAME: Baby
TEXT: Nobody puts baby in the corner! This little lady is looking to learn all about the world with you! She would suit short hours alone as a solo girl, or longer hours with a canine companion. Polite with dogs big or small, beautiful Baby has so much love to give and is searching for the right place to call home. If this Baby girl sounds like the perfect addition to your family, apply to take her home from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Irena
TEXT: Are you ready to be laughing with your newest furry friend? Well, Irena will have you cackling. She is a true definition of a little pocket rocket, she will be showing all aspects of her zoomies and how confident she is in doing so. Irena enjoys spending her days showing off and basking in the sunshine. She is loves companionship and will happily follow you anywhere you desire. Irena knows her name well and with a little bit of getting used to your voice she will come (running) straight back.

NAME: Ralph
TEXT: Are you after a little fire-cracker in your life? Look no further than our boy Ralph! He is all things active/fun-loving and absolutely hilarious; Ralph will have your grinning from ear to ear. Ralph would suit an active family with a backyard who can walk him daily and throw his favourite toy around, Ralph hasn't been exposed to an indoor setting as yet so may take some time adjusting but I think he will happily follow you around. His favourite game is showing his friends how quick his zoomies are so a nice backyard will do the trick so he can show off to you. If you're interested in hearing more about Ralph, please apply now.

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: Meet our big boy Bruce! He is a true delight to be around. He will make you laugh until you cackle. He will be happy to cruise around with you day in and out. He is a gorgeous character to boasts confidence. Bruce suffered a racing injury and required surgery on his front right leg so an experienced owner who knows when to slow down on the zoomies is ideal.

NAME: Moses
TEXT: Are you after a dog to be totally besotted by you? Well meet Moses, a quirky and loveable boy whose after his forever home. Moses boasts confidence and is extremely gentle in his approach. He has been around children 4+ and will request frequent pats. He has been brought up with a jack russel at home, but would benefit from a meet and greet prior to being adopted. Moses will be attending our Adoption Day at Glandore Wines on the 5th of October.

NAME: Stephen
TEXT: Meet Stephen ! a total sweetheart with a PhD in cuddling. 💙 Stephen is incredibly affectionate and absolutely adores people. He has a special love for his crate and all things soft and comfy, making him a champion napper and a joy to have indoors. While he’s social with medium to large dogs when out and about, Stephen would be happiest as the only dog in the home where he can soak up all the attention. Stephen has shown himself to be wonderful inside, so an apartment or quieter home where he can snooze on the couch and enjoy a relaxed routine would suit him perfectly. He has the potential to gradually work up to full-time hours, given time and patience. A home without kids, or with older, calm, and respectful children, would be ideal for this gentle soul. If you’re looking for a loving companion who’s all about comfort, closeness, and calm vibes, Stephen might just be your perfect match

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Spot is independent and enjoys spending time roaming around. Spot would suit a family who is after a companion to cruise around the backyard with. At times Spot can be weary and a bit timid in new environments but with the right re-assurance, she recovers really well. If you're interested in meeting our darling Spot, please apply now.

NAME: Axel
TEXT: Let me introduce Axel! Axel is a gentle and loving soul with a beautifully soft nature. He is friendly and sociable with all dogs when introduced and supervised properly. Axel will adapt well to full-time workers and is comfortable with children. Axel would thrive in a home with access to a yard. Axel would love to find a caring environment where he can enjoy affection, have outdoor space, and interact positively with other dogs and children.

NAME: Julian
TEXT: Julian is best described as a distinguished gentleman. He is calm, friendly and an easy-going boy who just goes about his day without a fuss. He's walked around busy streets, schools, shopping centres as well as farms and paddocks. Nothing much fazes Julian, including other large dogs, small dogs and children. He loves people and pats and loves a walk, rarely pulling. Julian would suit most households and make a very special and loving companion who wants to be with you.

NAME: Emmie
TEXT: Emmie is a lovely Greyhound with a heart full of affection and a playful spirit. Her endearing personality and love for canine companionship make her a delightful addition to any home. Emmie is a charming girl with a naturally sweet disposition. Her gentle and loving nature makes her a joy to be around. Emmie adores human company and thrives on affection. She’s always eager to share her love and will happily snuggle up for some quality bonding time. With a zest for life, Emmie enjoys playful activities and fun interactions. Whether it's a game of fetch, running around in the yard, or engaging in lively play, she brings energy and enthusiasm to every moment. Emmie has a great fondness for other dogs and enjoys their company. She’s friendly and sociable with canine companions, making her a great fit for a home with other dogs. If you’re looking for a Greyhound who is sweet, affectionate, and full of playful energy, Emmie could be the perfect match. Her love for people and canine friends alike ensures she’ll bring warmth and joy to your home.

NAME: Disco
TEXT: Disco is a spirited and delightful young Greyhound who is ready to bring boundless energy and joy into your life. Her playful nature and love for zoomies make her a perfect match for an active, young family. Disco is a charming young girl with a vibrant personality. Her enthusiasm and zest for life are truly infectious, making her a joy to be around. One of Disco’s favorite pastimes is having a good run, or “zoomies,” where she can let loose and show off her speedy moves. She’ll keep you entertained with her bursts of playful energy and speedy sprints. Disco’s lively nature and affectionate demeanor make her a fantastic fit for an active family. She’ll thrive in an environment where she can participate in family activities, play with kids, and enjoy regular exercise. If you’re looking for a Greyhound who is both loving and full of energy, Disco could be the perfect addition to your family. Her playful spirit and affectionate nature will bring a lot of joy and excitement to your home.

NAME: Sandy
TEXT: Sandy is a strikingly handsome Greyhound with a gentle and adventurous spirit. Though he may start off a bit shy, his love for exploration and quiet nature make him a wonderful companion for the right home. With his stunning looks and graceful presence, Sandy is sure to turn heads wherever he goes. His charm is matched by his graceful demeanor. Sandy may need a little time to warm up, but his shyness is simply a sign of his sensitive nature. Once he feels secure, his true, affectionate personality shines through. Sandy has a curious side and enjoys exploring new environments. Whether it’s a leisurely walk in the park or discovering new trails, his adventurous spirit makes every outing an exciting experience. If you’re looking for a handsome Greyhound with a gentle disposition who loves to explore and is happiest in a quiet, loving environment, Sandy could be the perfect addition to your family. He’s ready to embark on new adventures and bring his quiet charm into your life.

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Meet Gus: The Gentle Soul Gus is a serene and soft-natured Greyhound who thrives in a calm and loving environment. His gentle demeanor and shy personality make him a unique and endearing companion for the right home. Gus may be a bit reserved at first, but his gentle nature shines through once he feels comfortable. He’s the kind of dog who appreciates a quiet and patient approach, revealing his sweet personality in a calm and loving setting. Gus thrives in a peaceful environment where he can feel secure and relaxed. He’s not a fan of loud noises or bustling activities, so a tranquil home is ideal for him. Despite his shy nature, Gus is friendly and gets along well with other dogs. He enjoys their company and can be a great addition to a home with existing canine companions. If you’re looking for a sweet, soft-natured Greyhound who will flourish in a calm, loving home, Gus is the perfect match. He’s ready to bring his gentle presence and quiet companionship into your life.

NAME: Pam
TEXT: Pam is a friendly and well-adjusted greyhound who has had extensive positive interactions with other dogs and people. Her outgoing nature makes her a joy to be around and ensures she fits well into various social settings. Pam gets along exceptionally well with her canine companions. Her easygoing and sociable demeanor makes her a perfect playmate for other dogs, whether they’re big or small. Pam’s gentle and affectionate nature makes her an ideal choice for a young family. She’s patient, loving, and enjoys being part of family activities and playtime. Pam is a sweet, social, and family-oriented greyhound looking for a loving home where she can share her affectionate nature and enjoy being part of a young family’s daily life. If you’re looking for a friendly and well-rounded companion who gets along great with other dogs and is ready to be a cherished member of your family, Pam is the perfect match!

NAME: Sub
TEXT: Sub is a joyful greyhound whose enthusiasm and positive energy are truly contagious. She approaches each day with a wagging tail and a bright smile, spreading happiness wherever she goes. She is a high-energy girl who thrives on regular physical activity. Her zest for life is evident in her love for playtime and her eagerness to engage in various activities. Sub absolutely adores zoomies! She loves to let loose and sprint around her playful bursts of speed are a sight to behold. Sub is a vibrant and spirited greyhound looking for an energetic home where her zest for life can shine. If you’re ready to embrace her joyful nature and provide a dynamic environment, Sub is eager to become your new best friend!

NAME: Corene
TEXT: Corene carries herself with a natural poise and assurance. She navigates new environments and situations with a calm self-assuredness that makes her a standout companion. Corene loves to stay on the move. Whether it’s a brisk walk, a run in the park, or playtime in the backyard, she’s always ready for an adventure. Corene’s curiosity knows no bounds. She’s always exploring her surroundings with an eager eye, making sure she’s aware of all that’s happening around her. Corene gets along well with medium and large dogs. She’s confident and social, but her interactions are best suited for companions of similar size and energy levels. Smaller dogs may find her enthusiasm overwhelming. Corene is a spirited and delightful greyhound ready to bring her energy and enthusiasm into a loving home. If you’re looking for a confident and active companion, Corene might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Jasper
TEXT: Meet Jasper, a dashing greyhound with a heart as big as his gentle eyes! Jasper is the epitome of relaxation and charm, embodying the perfect blend of social butterfly and cuddle enthusiast. His easygoing nature makes him a breeze to be around, whether you're lounging at home or out for a stroll. Jasper thrives on affection and has a remarkable talent for making everyone he meets feel special. He’s a true connoisseur of hugs and pats, always ready to lean in for some extra love. His calm demeanor and friendly attitude make him a wonderful companion for both lively gatherings and quiet evenings. If you’re looking for a loving and relaxed furry friend who will brighten your days with his warm snuggles and cheerful presence, Jasper is your perfect match!

NAME: Nash
TEXT: Nash is a happy-go-lucky greyhound with a heart full of love and a spirit that’s impossible not to adore. This sweet and playful boy is the perfect addition to any family looking for a loyal and affectionate companion. With his friendly demeanor and boundless energy, Nash is a social butterfly who gets along with everyone he meets, making him an excellent family pet. Nash's enthusiasm for life is infectious. Whether he's playfully bounding around the yard or snuggling on the couch, his joy is evident and brings smiles to everyone around him. Nash is a true peoples dog, thriving in social settings and getting along splendidly with other pets and children. Nash is not just a pet; he’s a bundle of joy who brings endless happiness to those around him. If you’re looking for a sweet-natured, playful, and well-socialized greyhound to brighten your life, Nash is the perfect match. Come meet him and discover the joy he can bring into your home! Apply today!!

NAME: Crash
TEXT: Crash Is a spirited and joyful greyhound with a heart as big as his playful energy. True to his name, he loves to dash around with boundless enthusiasm, especially when a toy is involved. Crash's other favourite pastime is a splash in his shell pool! Crash is great with all other doggie friends and enjoys his interactions. He would make an ideal companion to an active family who loves life as much as he does! If Crash sounds like your man apply today!!

NAME: Bailey
TEXT: Are you looking for a new furry companion to help bring out of their shell? Bailey would be the ideal companion for you! Bailey is our beautiful nervous nelly, he loves his routine and the people he is around all the time, but new people can make him revert into his greyhound bubble. Bailey is searching for home that is quiet and will allow him the time to really show off his personality. He would suit an avid Knights fan as he enjoys spending his Sunday afternoons by the TV, Bailey enjoys basking in the sunshine and having a splash at the beach. He is currently living inside/outside and is quiet and relaxed, he is okay to be left alone so long as he is in his safe spot.

NAME: Bentley
TEXT: Meet our easy going, fun-loving boy Bentley. He ought to be the most handsome boy on the block, with responsive lead manners and some indoor house experience! Bentley approaches softly for lots of pats and loves to cuddle. He is a social butterfly when out and about meeting new people, he's always wants to say hello! He's eager to please and is so ready to jump straight into pet life.

NAME: Sam
TEXT: Meet Sam! Sam is quite a character and cannot wait to be the newest member of your family. He is always eager to get in on the action and be part of all the fun. Sam isn't shy and will say to everyone he passes. He is quite the socialist, so your daily walks will consist of meeting and greeting everyone that strolls past. He is relatively strong on the lead but will settle into his stride when he gets going. The ideal home for this charming boy would be one with an active lifestyle to help him channel his abundant energy.

NAME: Zarva
TEXT: Meet Zavra! Zarva is a very sweet natured boy. He is very curious & interested in the world. He positively interacts with those around him; children & smaller dogs :) Zarva wants to be involved. He'll be happy doing almost about anything. Whether it's a family movie day or spending a day outside going on adventures :) Enquire now & arrange to meet Zarva!

NAME: Maisie
TEXT: Meet Maisie! She might have the age of a senior lady, but definitely doesn't show it! Maisie is sweet curious girl. Eager to explore & learn. She might take a little while to warm up but once she does, she is full of character. Maisie would be best suited to a home with bigger dogs only, or a single dog home. Older kids to play with her preferred. Maisie would become a very loyal part of your home once settled & feeling comfortable :)

NAME: Uzzie
TEXT: Meet Uzzie, a laid-back and lovable four-legged friend known for his warm personality and love for life. Uzzie's easy-going nature makes him a relaxed companion, an ideal mate to have by your side while you enjoy a quiet cup of coffee or lazy Sunday afternoons. One of Uzzie's favourite pastimes is going for car rides. Just mention the word "ride", and he's ready and wagging! Whether going across town for a vet visit or heading into the countryside for an afternoon adventure, Uzzie is the perfect co-pilot. H Uzzie may not be a social butterfly, but he knows how to play well with his peers, especially small dogs. His friendly and calm disposition makes him a dream to have around, not just for humans but also for furry friends. If you already have a small dog in the house looking for a buddy, Uzzie could be the perfect companion. What's more - during quiet times, Uzzie is comfortable being independent and can sit quietly by your side while you sip your drink and carry on a conversation. He enjoys being around people, but he respects your space and knows when to give you your alone time. All in all, Uzzie is an easy-going, sociable, and well-mannered pet who would make a heartwarming addition to any family or individual looking for a calm and steady companion. He is all set for the next chapter of his life, and with just one look at his joyful wag, you'll see that Uzzie's ready to share some great times with you!

NAME: Chickadee
TEXT: Meet Chickadee, a friendly and playful, loving gentleman who is ready to meet his new family. This delightful dog is known for his fun-loving and amiable personality, and he's eager to share his heart with a compassionate, affectionate family. Chickadee has a wonderful rapport with children, especially those 8 years and older. He's not the sort who will tire out your kids with endless games of fetch, but prefers to spend time in children's company, quietly keeping them company while they do their homework or read stories. He loves leaning into a hearty pat and will choose to cuddle up next to you over toys any day. An interesting fact about Chickadee is that while he is a dog, he prefers the company of humans over other dogs. He's quite selective with his canine friends and might come off as aloof with dogs, particularly the smaller ones, which makes him ideally suited for a home where he can be the only pet. Chickadee is looking to bring his friendly and playful nature into a family who will offer him the same kindness and playfulness that he offers others in spades. He's ready for the next step and hopes to find a loving, forever home with a protective family to cherish him.

NAME: Alley
TEXT: Meet Alley, our friendly, senior female pup with a heart as golden as her years. Despite her age, Alley still carries a spark of puppyish charm in her eyes, making everyday feel like an adventure. Alley possesses the superb ability to bring life and joy into any room, with her boundless affection and unwavering loyalty. Well-socialised and incredibly friendly, Alley has had a great rapport with other small dogs and her fellow greyhounds. Her gentle and easygoing nature means she can find common ground with just about any dog she meets. She has even been socialised with cats and could probably coexist peacefully with the right feline friend. Alley's age doesn't slow her down. She has the physical agility of a much younger dog and loves playtime and walkies as much as curling up for a nap. Alley enjoys her walks and would be a wonderful companion to explore the neighbourhood parks with. Her ability to make friends so easily would also mean plenty of playdates with other dogs! As Alley's future family, you will be cherished with her loving gaze and affectionate rubs. If you're in search of an older, wiser pup who still knows how to have fun like a youngster, Alley just might be the loving companion you've been waiting for. Come meet her and let her amiable spirit brighten up your life!

NAME: Meg
TEXT: Meg is the epitome of gentle charm, with a touch of bashfulness that adds to his irresistible appeal. This shy guy isn't just looking for any home; he's on a quest for his own private sanctuary, where he can be the star of the show without any pesky co-stars stealing his spotlight. Meg's motto? "One dog, one throne!" He's not one for sharing his kingdom, but he'll gladly share his love with respectful children who understand the art of giving him space but love when he likes. With Meg around, every day is an adventure filled with quiet moments of contemplation, punctuated by bursts of zoomies when no one's looking. So, if you're ready to welcome a regal greyhound into your castle and bask in the glory of his majestic presence then Meg is the dashing companion you've been searching for. Contact our Western Sydney facility to arrange a meet and greet and get ready to embark on a journey of laughter, love, and endless tail wags with this shy but lovable boy!

NAME: Sandy
TEXT: Introducing Sandy, a beautiful and gentle girl who is ready to bring a ton of joy into your life! Known for her soft and gentle demeanor, Sandy possesses the ability to fill any room with calmness and love. Sandy is not just a dog; she's a friend and companion. Her kind and loving nature ensures that she gets along beautifully with both children and other dogs. She is known for her soft, soulful eyes that seem to look straight into your heart. What Sandy would love the most is a family that showers her with the same affection that she effortlessly gives to others. In her new home, Sandy would enjoy a cozy corner to curl up in, a safe garden to explore, and a family that she can love and be loved by. Sandy is just waiting to create numerous wonderful memories with a family who adores her. She promises a lifetime of love and dedication to those who welcome her into their heart.

NAME: Wighton
TEXT: Hello! My name is Wighton. I was known as Four Five on the racing tracks, but I hung up my racing collar late last year. I'm a courteous fellow, though I may take a little time to open up. Once I'm comfortable, I love to display my energetic zoomies. I've encountered several small dogs and they don't pique my interest much. I'm looking for a home with a backyard where I can have some space to myself from time to time. And, if you could take me on walks, that would be wonderful. I am looking forward to meeting my new human companions, so be sure to hit the 'apply' button when you can.

NAME: Lara
TEXT: Meet Lara! Lara hails from a sociable household where she has interacted with a Maltese terrier and frequently plays her fellow hound siblings. Initially, Lara may appear somewhat reserved, but with a touch of affection, care, and cuddles, she quickly warms up. She tends to be indifferent towards smaller dogs, often seeking reassurance from humans when they are present. With a lively spirit, Lara would be thrilled if her new human friends could take her on walks to let her energy out. Hit apply today to chat about your possible new addition.

NAME: Joseph
TEXT: Say hello to Joseph, our big, strong, and friendly boy who's eager to share his love with you. With his endearing personality and playful energy, Joseph is certain to light up your life and home. This social butterfly is always ready to meet and greet new people but because of his size and strength, Joseph needs a home where he can get plenty of exercise and mental stimulation. He is well-suited for an active adult or older children household, where he can satisfy his need for engagement and play. Joseph can be quite excitable and has a lot of love to give, so he's more comfortable in a single-dog household where he can be the star of the show. Despite his size, he's a charming boy who's always eager to please his family. In summary, Joseph is a delightful mixed bag of quirkiness, exuberance, and love. If you're ready for a dog who can match your energy and zest for life, Joseph could be your perfect companion. He is waiting to show his new family just what a loving and fun-filled life they can have together.

NAME: Tank
TEXT: Tank is a gentle, kind doggy soul encased in a robust, athletic body. Don't let his strong, sturdy name fool you, Tank is soft and loving, and his friendly nature is sure to win everyone over in no time. He is exceptionally well-behaved, maintaining cleanliness with a natural knack for it, making him the perfect addition to your household. Although he has an energetic spirit, he always manages to channel his proud doggy energy in the most polite, fun ways. Tank has a special place in his heart for kids. He loves their boundless energy, their playful antics, and the endless tummy rubs they're always willing to share. Their laughter is music to his ears, and seeing them happy makes his tail wag harder! Friendly to his core, Tank gets along well with everyone he meets. He's a four-legged ambassador of goodwill, spreading joy wherever he goes. His ideal day consists of playful frolicking in the yard, a delightful nap in his comfy bed, and of course, lots of tasty treats! Tank's loving spirit and fun-loving nature make him a perfect family pet. He's excited to bring lots of joy, love, and incredible memories to his new family. So, if you're ready to add a sweet, loving, and well-behaved dog to your family, Tank is definitely your guy!

NAME: Miss Ling
TEXT: Miss Ling is a big snuggle bunny. She is sweet and affectionate and will seek out affection Described as a happy girl she will bring a ray of sunshine to your life and be happy to be by your side through thick and thin. Miss Ling may be on the other side of 9 but she still has a lot of love to share and is looking for the right person to shower her love on

NAME: Luna
TEXT: Say hello to Luna, a sociable and friendly female dog who is sure to win your heart. Luna's radiant persona lights up every room she enters, and her charming nature has a contagious effect that brightens up everyone around her. Luna's love for people is truly one of her fine characteristics. She adores being in the company of humans and is a strong advocate for endless belly rubs, cuddles, and ear scratches. She thrives off attention and relishes in making every moment delightful for you, and herself of course. Interactive playtime is Luna's favorite! She gets immense joy out of chasing toys, whether it's a game of fetch or squeaky toys that catch her attention. This playful activity helps Luna stimulate her mind and use her attentive nature to the best of her abilities. In a dog community, Luna prefers the companionship of medium to large breed dogs. She blends well with her fellow canine mates, her easygoing nature allowing her to adapt quickly to their play style. This adaptability makes her the perfect addition to a family with a medium to large breed dog. In stepping into Luna's life, be prepared for an overflow of love and memorable moments. Luna is ready to love her new family wholeheartedly, and promises to bring with her a bundle of joy, laughter, and playful adventures.

NAME: Toby
TEXT: Nightmare? Bad dream? Don't worry, sometimes names ARE deceiving, because our boy Toby, former Race Name Scary Dream, is anything but scary! ✅ Beautiful nature, a genuinely sweet duffer ✅ Big softie: this boy is your quintessential "gentle giant." He does get excited, but is very kind-hearted and means well. ✅ Very friendly and human social. Nothing makes him happier than being with his people. ✅ Loves hopping on the lounge and laying with you. Disclaimer: he's big and likes to hog most of the couch space! ✅ Enjoys playing, having fun, and just living his best life ✅ He can be exuberant and boisterous to start (oh my god life is so exciting!!) - but he does settle and eventually wants to find a lounge. ✅ Has been living inside his current home everyday - and is becoming quite accustomed to the spoils of pet life! ✅ Like most men, Toby LOVES his food! This will help with training as he is very easily influenced when free food is on offer! ✅ This patient boy settles when in the car or trailer ✅ Best suited as the only dog in the household - more attention for Toby 😉 ✅ The only hound Toby wouldn't mind sharing his new forever home with is his sister-from-another-mister: Winnie (Microchip: 956000009482109). - They currently live inside together and don't mind sharing all the love and attention. - Winnie is also available for adoption: https://www.gapnsw.com.au/our-greyhounds/winnie-2 Toby will need a bit of time to settle into his new home - it's a big transition moving to a new house. But with a bit of love and patience, you will be rewarded with a sweet, but funny, but lovable larrikin. Toby hasn't had the chance to interact with children yet. So would need a nice meet and greet to see how everybody goes, if potentially going into a home with kids. He is a big strong boy so likely would be best with older children. This sturdy lad is strong on lead - there's a big world out there and oh so little time, Toby feels like he must concur it stat! He does settle, and with a little training and patience will be a good walking companion or social wing man. Toby will be 6 at the end of January! Nothing bonds a family and new boy better than a birthday party right?!

NAME: Lucky
TEXT: BOO!! Just kidding, it's in Lucky aka Phantom Ghost's nature to be a bit of a mysterious jokester! But don't be spooked by his former Race Name "Phantom Ghost" - as he is also Lucky! And you'll be feeling lucky too punk once you have our Lucky in your life: ✅ Very happy chap who somehow looks like he's always smiling! ✅ Loves people! He will give ample affection - but secretly hopes he gets it in return too! ✅ Has interacted with other dogs: - Regularly interacts with other Greyhounds - Has met a little West Highland Terrier and Italian Greyhound. Lucky was a little pushy to start but did settle once the novelty wore off. - He would be suited to other Medium-Large breed dogs - Lucky will need very slow, patient, and gradual introductions when meeting any new dogs ✅ Good with older children: - Lucky has only interacted with older kids - He can excited however (new friends! new friends!) and jump. Once he is told No he will settle. Continued training with this will help him learn. Lucky has lived in a kennel environment all of his life, so hopes his new family understand he will need a little time and patience to settle into his new world. If you think you should be so lucky, enquire about our Lucky aka "Phantom Ghost" below!

NAME: Tori
TEXT: Looking to spruce up your abode? We have some styling tips: Simply add the stunning Tori aka "Rattlin' Style" into your house! You'll be all the fashion and talk of the town! She recognizes their gentle and caring presence, and her natural instincts guide her to be extra gentle and patient. - Tori is the kind of dog who will offer a warm nuzzle or a gentle paw to her young humans, ensuring an unbreakable bond. ✅ Tori is a good, polite girl in her kennel. ✅ This clever lass has an understanding of appropriate conduct and is respectful of boundaries. ✅ Good with Medium-Large breed dogs: - Regularly interacts with other Greyhounds. - Tori interacts best with male Greyhounds. - She would need very slow, gradual introductions to any new dogs. ✅ Tori loves her toys! Watching her play is a joy in itself. Her evident fun and energy is contagious! - so both Tori and you can have a grand old time! Tori will need a fully fenced yard. If having a devoted dame in your life sounds like a pretty picture, then Enquire or Apply to Adopt Tori (Rattlin' Style) to style up your home 😉 She may just improve your life and happiness too!

NAME: Caeden
TEXT: Hi everyone my name is Caeden. As you can see I'm a beautiful brindle boy looking for my perfect home. I am quite an active boy so my ideal home would be to someone who doesn't mind exercising me and spending a bit of time keeping me occupied. I am an alert boy and I like to know what is happening around me. I love socialising with my current family and am used to children and some other dogs. I am smart, well mannered and would love to join you in the adventures of life! I'd love to meet you and become your best mate.

NAME: Scamp
TEXT: Hi my name is Scamp! As my name suggests I am a mischievous but likeable boy (a big goof really). I am not naughty but just a bit of a character. I love playing and getting stirred up, I will run around and engage in play with you. I am a big boy with a big roman nose which may not appeal to everyone but I think I'm pretty handsome! I do enjoy a bit of exercise so someone a little active or an active family with older children would be perfect. I enjoy people and getting attention, am happy go lucky and would make a great companion, all I need is a chance! If you are interested in adopting or even fostering me apply and the team at GAP can organise a meet and greet.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: Just like his namesake in the movies Rocky could be your favorite underdog! Rocky is outgoing and friendly, loves pats and being spoilt by his human companions. He would suit a home that is moderately active as he likes a bit of a run and zoom around the yard. Rocky will really bond with his new owner and become a loyal companion. He has been socialised with his little pug friend but does require a little time when meeting new friends. If you have a bit of time for a new friend and are looking for a diamond in the rough apply to meet Rocky today!
